title: Site Engineer
description:
**WE’RE HIRING | CIVIL SITE ENGINEER**

**DESIGN ADDRESS | Kochi, Kerala**

We are looking for an experienced and technically sound
**Civil Engineer**
to join our team for full-time site supervision and project execution.

The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of civil engineering, hands-on construction experience, and the ability to independently supervise multiple project sites, ensuring quality, safety, and timely execution.

**🔹 Key Responsibilities**

* Supervise and manage day-to-day civil construction activities across multiple project sites.
* Conduct detailed site inspections, including structural works, reinforcement, formwork, concreting, masonry, plastering, waterproofing, and finishing works.
* Verify construction quality, structural dimensions, levels, alignments, and workmanship against approved drawings and specifications.
* Take overall responsibility for site execution, coordination, quality control, and progress monitoring.

* Identify construction defects, technical issues, and deviations, and ensure timely corrective action.
* Monitor material requirements, site measurements, work schedules, and project deadlines.

* Strong technical knowledge of civil engineering, structural works, construction methods, and building materials.
* Practical experience in site inspection, quality control, and construction execution.

* Capable of independently handling multiple project sites.
* Good leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* **Valid two-wheeler and four-wheeler driving licences are mandatory.**
* Willingness to travel regularly between project sites.

title: Founders Office - Intern
description:
**Company Description**

KLYNE is a premium unisex fragrance brand that creates mood-based perfumes for the modern Indian consumer. The brand is built on the belief that fragrance is a powerful form of self-expression and an integral part of everyday identity. KLYNE combines exceptional quality, long-lasting performance, and accessible luxury, using ingredients sourced from leading global fragrance houses and developed to IFRA standards. Backed by angel investment, the company is focused on making premium perfumery more personal, relevant, and accessible through a modern, emotion-driven approach to fragrance and world-class craftsmanship.

**What You Will Do**

• Work directly with the Founder on daily priorities, decision making, and execution

• Assist in strategy, planning, marketing, operations - wear different hats in a day

• Support product launch activities and coordination with agencies, vendors, and internal teams

• Help with market research, consumer insights, and competitive analysis

• Support brand, marketing, and content initiatives

• Assist in operations, partnerships, and business development

• Prepare presentations, documents, reports, and follow ups

• Take ownership and solve problems across functions in a fast moving startup environment

**What We Are Looking For**

• Highly proactive, detail oriented, and execution focused

• Strong communication and organizational skills

• Comfortable working in a fast paced and ambiguous startup environment

• Ability to think independently and take ownership

•
**Interest in consumer brands, startups, beauty, perfumes, or D2C
﻿**

**What You Will Gain**

• Strong opportunity to convert into a full-time role based on performance

• Real responsibility and meaningful work

• End to end understanding of building a funded consumer brand

• Exposure across strategy, brand, operations, and growth

* **Internship stipend will be Rs 10k/month. Potential to convert to a full-time role based on performance. All the members of the current team joined KLYNE as Interns**

title: RC FS -BTI INS -Life and Annuity -Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY GDS Business Consulting – Life & Annuity Senior position:**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
As part of our Consulting team, you will play a key role in supporting clients across the individual and group life insurance and annuity value chain. You will contribute to complex transformation programs by applying deep product, process, and platform knowledge, while helping clients achieve their business objective. This role provides the opportunity to work across multi vendor environments, influence strategic business decisions, and contribute to large scale transformation initiatives for insurance careers.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Support clients across the full policy lifecycle, including new business, underwriting, policy servicing, billing, claims, disbursements, and regulatory updates.
* Create comprehensive business process maps, future state architectures, and work breakdown structures (WBS) for conversion and transformation programs.
* Lead requirements elicitation through JAD sessions, workshops, and collaboration with product owners to develop BRDs, FSDs, and other documentation.
* Challenge new requirements and change requests by proposing optimized, value driven solutions that align with business strategy and operational readiness.
* Collaborate with product design and development teams to evaluate functional enhancements and ensure they meet business objectives.
* Support clients through product configuration decisions, acceptance criteria definition, and user acceptance testing.
* Contribute to data migration and data governance activities, ensuring quality, compliance, and seamless system transitions.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to clients by delivering clear insights, process improvements, and best practice recommendations
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* A proactive, detail‑oriented professional who thrives in fast‑paced, dynamic environments.
* Strong business acumen combined with deep expertise in life and annuity insurance domains.
* Ability to collaborate effectively and bridge the gap between business needs and technology solutions.
* A strategic problem‑solver who challenges assumptions and recommends innovative, future‑ready approaches.
* A committed team player focused on delivering value, driving transformation, and building lasting client relationships

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Bachelors degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.)
* Approximately 5 to 10 years of experience working in Life & Annuity insurance domain.

**Additionally, You’ll Also Have**

* Hands‑on experience with policy lifecycle processes and insurance operational workflows.
* Ability to produce high‑quality process maps, data flows, and requirement documentation.
* Proficiency in managing multi‑vendor engagements and navigating complex project environments.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data, identify gaps, and propose practical solutions.
* Excellent communication and facilitation skills for client‑facing interactions.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with technical, functional, and business stakeholders.

**Ideally, good to have**

* Experience working on data migration projects and applying data governance best practices.
* Knowledge of insurance COTS platforms such as FAST, ALIP, OIPA, wmA etc
* Certifications such as AAPA or LOMA.
* Understanding of upstream and downstream integrations across the policy lifecycle
* Knowledge of project management tools like JIRA, TFS, Azure DevOps

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: SME-Learning & Development
description:
**Job Summary**
This hybrid role as a subject matter expert in learning and development focuses on creating and delivering training solutions for claims adjudication and health care compliance within provider and payer environments. The position supports night shift operations enabling global coverage while ensuring accurate claims handling regulatory alignment and continuous capability building across multiple functional teams.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design comprehensive training programs that build strong capability in claims adjudication processes for provider and payer operations while aligning with current business objectives and quality standards.
* Develop detailed learning content that simplifies complex health care claim rules and workflows so that new and existing team members can perform adjudication tasks with high accuracy and consistency.
* Deliver engaging virtual and classroom training sessions during night shift hours to support hybrid team members and ensure consistent knowledge transfer across locations.
* Conduct targeted training needs analysis by collaborating with operations and quality teams to identify skill gaps in claims adjudication and prioritize high impact learning interventions.
* Monitor learner performance data and quality audit outcomes to refine course materials and ensure that training directly improves claim resolution accuracy and turnaround time.
* Ensure that all learning content reflects current health care regulations and privacy requirements related to HIPAA so that team members handle sensitive information responsibly.
* Create practical simulations and case based exercises that mirror real life provider and payer claim scenarios to help learners build confidence and decision making skills.
* Provide ongoing floor support during production hours by answering process queries and clarifying adjudication rules so that associates can resolve complex claims efficiently.
* Collaborate with process experts and compliance teams to update training materials whenever there are changes in benefit designs coding standards or regulatory guidance.
* Track training effectiveness through feedback surveys assessments and quality metrics and present insights that show how learning programs support business performance and member satisfaction.
* Maintain detailed training records and documentation that support internal audits and demonstrate adherence to organizational learning standards and regulatory expectations.
* Coordinate with workforce management and team supervisors to schedule training sessions that minimize business disruption while meeting the needs of night shift hybrid associates.
* Support the adoption of digital learning tools and knowledge repositories so that team members can access updated claims adjudication and HIPAA guidance on demand.

**Qualifications**

* Apply strong knowledge of health care claims adjudication rules benefit structures and payment policies to design technically accurate learning content for provider and payer processes.
* Use hands on experience with provider and payer workflows to explain real world scenarios and guide learners in applying policy rules to complex claim situations.
* Apply working knowledge of HIPAA requirements and data privacy expectations to embed compliance guidelines into every stage of the learning and support process.
* Utilize prior operations or quality experience within claims environments to connect training topics with performance outcomes such as first pass resolution and reduced rework.
* Demonstrate proficiency with common office productivity tools and learning platforms to create clear presentations job aids and reference guides for hybrid teams.
* Communicate clearly and inclusively with diverse audiences across global locations while adapting explanations to suit different experience levels and learning styles.
* Show readiness to work permanent night shifts in a hybrid work model while maintaining high levels of responsiveness reliability and collaboration with onshore and offshore partners.

title: Naval Architect
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

We are looking for a skilled and motivated Naval Architect to join our Naval Architecture team at S&O Maritime Services Pvt. is seeking a skilled Naval Architect to support Naval Architecture projects, including basic and production design, engineering calculations, and project coordination. The ideal candidate should have strong technical knowledge, project management skills, and the ability to coordinate with multidisciplinary teams to deliver quality engineering solutions within project timelines.

**POSITION**

Naval Architect

**COMPANY**

S&O Maritime Services Pvt. Ltd.

**LOCATION**

Aluva, Kerala

**EMPLOYMENT TYPE**

Full-Time | Permanent

(Preference will be given to candidates who are flexible and willing to undertake on-site deployments at shipyards, client locations, and marine or offshore project sites as required).

**EXPERIENCE**

2 - 4 Years of Relevant Experience

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

*A. Project Management, Basic Design and Production Design*

1. **Basic Design Coordination**
   : Coordinate and manage basic design activities, including preparation and review of general arrangement (GA) drawings, preliminary vessel layouts, design specifications, and other relevant naval architecture deliverables in accordance with project requirements.
2. **Production Design Coordination**
   : Coordinate production design activities, including detailed engineering drawings, fabrication drawings, structural details, and production documentation, ensuring alignment with approved basic designs and shipyard requirements.
3. **Project Planning and Progress Monitoring**
   : Plan and monitor engineering activities, track project schedules and deliverables, coordinate with multidisciplinary teams, and ensure timely completion of assigned work packages while maintaining effective communication with project managers, clients, and other stakeholders.
4. **Technical Review and Project Execution**
   : Review design deliverables for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with project specifications. Identify technical issues, coordinate corrective actions, support material take-offs and engineering documentation, and contribute to quality control throughout project execution.

*B. Basic Design Calculations, Stability and Ship Structure Analysis*

1. **Basic Design Calculations:**
   Perform preliminary naval architecture calculations, including hydrostatics, displacement, weight estimation, centre of gravity, trim, draft, and other relevant calculations required to support vessel design and development.
2. **Vessel Stability Analysis**
   : Perform preliminary intact stability calculations and assessments, evaluate relevant stability parameters, and support verification against applicable design criteria, classification requirements, and project specifications.
3. **Ship Structure Analysis**
   : Assist in ship structural analysis and strength assessments, including evaluation of structural arrangements, loads, scantlings, and structural integrity in coordination with structural engineers and in accordance with applicable design requirements.
4. **Engineering Calculations and Technical Documentation**
   : Prepare, review, and maintain calculation sheets, analysis reports, design assumptions, and supporting technical documentation. Coordinate with design and structural teams to resolve discrepancies and ensure consistency between engineering calculations, drawings, and project requirements.

**REQUIREMENTS**

**Educational Qualification**

* B.Tech / B.E. in Naval Architecture.

**Experience**

* 2 - 4 years of relevant experience in naval architecture, ship design, shipbuilding, marine engineering, vessel conversion, or offshore engineering.
* Experience in coordinating engineering activities, managing project deliverables, and working with multidisciplinary technical teams is preferred.

**Skills**

*Technical and Professional Skills*

* **Naval Architecture Fundamentals**
  : Good understanding of vessel design principles, hydrostatics, displacement, weight estimation, centre of gravity, trim, draft, and basic vessel stability calculations.
* **Design, Analysis and Engineering Software**
  : Candidates are expected to demonstrate proficiency in relevant software tools from the following list, depending on their area of expertise and project requirements:

Autodesk AutoCAD

Autodesk Inventor

SOLIDWORKS

Rhinoceros (Rhino 3D)

AVEVA

ShipConstructor

CADMATIC

Tekla Structures

MOSES

AutoShip

AutoHydro

AutoPower

OpenFOAM

SESAM

ANSYS

Bentley STAAD.Pro

PV Elite

* **Engineering Drawings and Documentation**
  : Ability to prepare, interpret, and review general arrangement (GA) drawings, lines plans, vessel layouts, hull forms, technical specifications, and engineering calculation reports.
* **Marine Engineering and Construction:**
  Basic understanding of hull structures, ship construction methods, marine materials, welding, fabrication processes, and interfaces between naval architecture and structural engineering.
* **Classification and Regulatory Requirements**
  : Familiarity with classification society rules, including DNV, ABS, Lloyd's Register, and Bureau Veritas, as well as applicable IMO regulations and client-specific requirements.
* **Project Planning and Coordination:**
  Ability to organize engineering activities, track project schedules, monitor deliverables, coordinate resources, and manage multiple assignments within agreed timelines.
* **Technical Problem-Solving and Quality**
  : Ability to identify engineering discrepancies, assess technical challenges, review design outputs, and recommend practical, safe, and cost-effective solutions.

·        
**Professional Skills**
: Effective communication, teamwork, task ownership, technical documentation, and proficiency in MS Office and project tracking tools.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* Opportunity to work on marine and offshore engineering projects.
* Exposure to vessel design, shipbuilding, marine systems, and engineering project execution.
* Opportunities to develop technical expertise, project management capabilities, and leadership skills.
* Opportunity to work with experienced engineers and multidisciplinary technical teams.
* Supportive and collaborative work environment.
* Career growth opportunities based on performance, technical expertise, and leadership capabilities.
* Competitive salary in accordance with industry standards, qualifications, experience, and technical expertise.

**TO APPLY**

Interested candidates are invited to submit their updated CV/Resume with the subject:

**“Application – Naval Architect”**
Email: admin@sandomaritime.com

**WORK TYPE**

* Work Type: In-Person
* Employment: Full-Time | Permanent (Preference will be given to candidates willing to undertake on-site deployments at shipyards, client locations, and marine/offshore project sites).
* Working Hours: 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM

**PAY**

Salary will be offered in accordance with industry standards and based on qualifications, relevant experience, technical expertise, and project management capabilities.

**WORK LOCATION**

S&O Maritime Services Pvt. Ltd.

Aluva, Kerala, India

description:

Full-time

On-site

A&S Management Consultancy, based in Bahrain, is a trusted partner for organizations seeking expert management consultancy services. The firm combines deep knowledge of local market dynamics with global best practices to deliver strategic, tailored solutions. Its services include business advisory, company formation and amendments, company liquidation, and accounting and bookkeeping support for businesses at various stages of growth.

The Operations Coordinator will be responsible for supporting the smooth day-to-day operations of consultancy services, client management, administrative activities, and business development. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Kochi.

The role involves coordinating operational workflows, maintaining documentation, assisting with basic accounting activities, managing client communications, tracking leads, conducting product demonstrations, and following up with prospective customers to support sales conversion.

The ideal candidate should be organized, proactive, comfortable multitasking, and capable of coordinating with clients and internal teams while maintaining high standards of service and operational efficiency.

* Coordinate daily operational activities and ensure timely completion of assigned tasks.
* Manage client communications, inquiries, appointments, meetings, and follow-ups.
* Maintain company records, client documentation, reports, and project-related information.
* Assist with basic accounting activities, including invoice preparation, expense tracking, payment follow-ups, and maintaining financial records.
* Manage incoming leads, maintain the CRM database, and follow up with prospective clients.
* Conduct product demonstrations and presentations for Zoho applications, ERP systems, and other business software solutions.
* Understand customer requirements, explain suitable solutions, address basic objections, and support lead conversion and deal closing.
* Coordinate with technical and implementation teams to track project progress and ensure timely delivery.
* Prepare operational reports, update performance metrics, and monitor pending tasks.
* Provide administrative support, including scheduling, documentation, and office coordination.
* Handle multiple responsibilities simultaneously while prioritizing urgent tasks and meeting deadlines.
* Identify operational gaps and suggest improvements to internal processes and customer experience.
* Support sales and business development activities to help the company achieve its business objectives.

Qualifications and Skills

* **Operations Management:**
  Ability to coordinate workflows, manage daily activities, prioritize tasks, and ensure adherence to internal processes.
* **Communication Skills:**
  Excellent verbal and written communication skills for interacting with clients, colleagues, and prospective customers.
* **Lead Management and Closing Skills:**
  Ability to follow up on leads, understand customer requirements, handle objections, negotiate professionally, and convert prospects into customers.
* **Product Demonstration Skills:**
  Confidence in conducting software demonstrations and presentations, particularly for Zoho applications, ERP systems, and business management solutions.
* **Basic Accounting Skills:**
  Understanding of basic accounting principles, invoice preparation, expense tracking, payment follow-ups, and financial record maintenance.
* **Multitasking and Time Management:**
  Ability to manage multiple assignments, handle competing priorities, meet deadlines, and coordinate operations, administration, accounting, and sales activities.
* **Customer Service:**
  Ability to handle customer inquiries professionally, resolve routine issues, and maintain positive client relationships.
* **Analytical Skills:**
  Ability to track leads, monitor performance indicators, prepare reports, and support business decisions.
* **Administrative Skills:**
  Experience in maintaining records, preparing documents, scheduling meetings, and supporting office operations.
* **Technical Proficiency:**
  Working knowledge of MS Office, Excel or Google Sheets, CRM systems, and ERP software. Familiarity with Zoho applications is an advantage.
* **Teamwork and Adaptability:**
  Ability to work independently and collaboratively, learn new systems quickly, and adapt to changing business requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

* Diploma or bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Accounting, Marketing, or a related field.
* Prior experience in operations coordination, customer support, inside sales, business development, or software consultancy is an advantage.
* Experience with Zoho products, ERP software, accounting systems, or CRM platforms is desirable.
* A target-oriented mindset with an interest in customer engagement, software solutions, and business growth.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for a responsible, organized, and proactive professional who can manage daily operations while supporting customer relationships and business development. The candidate should be comfortable with basic accounting, multitasking, software demonstrations, lead follow-ups, and sales conversion activities.

The ideal candidate will combine strong coordination and administrative abilities with a customer-focused approach and a willingness to learn business software solutions.

title: Specialist, Engineering Services
description:
Being the go-to MEP/CIVIL person
  
  
Are you considered to be the go-to person for all MEP/CIVIL matters? That’s what you’ll be in this role. You’ll manage all activities related to mechanical, engineering and plumbing in terms of planning, designing, procurement, construction, testing and commissioning, and final handover. Your task is to fully understand, collect and deliver clients’ MEP/CIVIL requirements. The design manager in MEP/CIVIL will depend on you to help schedule or plan establishment, value engineer, and design change management. You’ll also assist the contract manager in MEP/CIVIL-related procurement and VO management. On top of that, you’ll support the construction manager in MEP/CIVIL-related installation, site inspection and contractor management.
  
  
Making visions come true
  
  
You’ll develop big ideas that will spark the effective management and successful execution of all phases of a project—from initiating, designing, planning, controlling, executing, monitoring, and closing. You’ll need to carefully identify and take note of our clients’ needs, and figure out what exactly needs to be done. This involves defining the scope of the work and expected outcome, while also detailing all the necessary objectives to get there.
  
  
While you do all of these, you’ll need to keep tabs on company resources used in the projects, and to allocate these resources to complete the project within the budget. You’ll also need to help clients organize and analyze all tender and procurement for all contractors and suppliers; and represent them from the beginning to the end of a project.
  
  
Building strong teams and business reputation
  
  
One of your priorities will be to produce high-performing teams that drive successful project execution. You’ll also represent and promote the company throughout projects and in pursuit of more project opportunities.
  
  
Keeping risks at bay
  
  
How do you deal with risks? You’ll need to identify any potential risks in the MEP/CIVIL field and report them to the Project Manager. It will be critical to design a risk management and solution provision, particularly to identify health & safety issues. You will understand why this is your responsibility.
  
  
**Sound like you? To apply you need to be:**
An MEP/CIVIL pro
  
  
You have a degree in MEP/CIVIL engineering-related discipline or related field, and five years of combined educational and work experience. You also need to have sufficient experience in construction site management, as well as a strong understanding of all aspects of development management including, financial appraisal, risk management, negotiation, etc.
  
  
Do you have a strong background of all aspects of MEP/CIVIL-related management—including the development of MEP/CIVIL project plan and procedures and construction schedules? Are you familiar with HVAC, electrical engineering, and BMS? Do you have knowledge of security system, AV system, and IT system? If your answers are yes, let’s talk.
  
  
A business savvy leader who can walk the talk
  
  
You understand the business well enough, particularly in terms of the systems and tools to use, the best practices and the safety requirements. You’re also knowledgeable of key industries and local market, with the real estate and construction business above all. You also have a basic understanding of the key drivers that push the projects forward, while also considering the client’s business requirements.
  
  
You’ll back up your business know-hows with the necessary communication skills, as you need to regularly do business development presentations to potential clients in both English and Chinese. You’ll also manage site activities, negotiate with contractors, review the legal aspects of contracts, contribute to market analysis, and manage change orders.
  
  
A flexible leader with superb interpersonal skills
  
  
Are you a people person with superb interpersonal skills? You’ll need to create a proactive working environment that not only motivates your employees, but also encourages them to maintain good relationship with clients, communicate effectively with each other, and contribute enthusiastically to the project. You also need to be a results-oriented leader with good problem-solving skills, as well as someone who can nurture positive relationships with all stakeholders involved, including your team members and clients.
  
  
**What we can do for you:**

title: Senior Manager, R&D (New Products)
description:
**Senior Manager, R&D (New Products)**
**About The Company**
Metantz connects the top 1% talents to global opportunities. This is an exciting opportunity with our award-winning customer, a deeptech ROV company, setting category benchmarks. They are a Kochi-based deep-tech company building underwater robots for places people can’t safely reach: dams, ports, ships and offshore infrastructure. Defence, government, infrastructure and energy customers in India and abroad already use our systems in the field. We are expanding our product portfolio, and we need a hands-on product leader to take the next generation of robots from idea to field-ready product.
  
  
**The role**
You will own the new product development pipeline and report to the CTO. This is not a pure research role, and it is not a sustaining-engineering role for existing products. You will turn emerging customer and mission needs into new, reliable, manufacturable robotic products. You will lead a multi-disciplinary team through concept, prototype, field trials and handover to production.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Define the new-product roadmap with the CTO and CEO, based on customer needs, market gaps and technology feasibility.
* Run new-product programs end to end: requirements, architecture, prototype, field trials, design freeze and production handover.
* Lead and mentor a multi-disciplinary team across mechanical, electronics, embedded, software, controls, sensors and communications.
* Run proof-of-concept and prototype cycles quickly, with clear go/no-go gates so that experiments don’t drift into commitments.
* Set up disciplined testing: lab, environmental, endurance and field trials. Feed every failure back into the design.
* Keep production handovers clean, with complete drawings, BOMs, firmware versions and test procedures.
* Work with Sales and customers on feasibility, estimates and early pilots for new products, and manage scope on custom requests.
* Manage program budgets, vendors, partners and component choices, including obsolescence and single-source risks.
* Contribute to IP creation and protection (patents, design records, documentation).
* Work closely with the existing product, production and field teams so that new products build on proven platforms.

**You might be a fit if you have**

* 8–12 years of experience in engineering and R&D, including 3+ years leading teams or programs.
* Experience at a robotics or drone company (UAV, UGV, marine or other autonomous systems), with new products taken from concept to field deployment.
* Hands-on depth in at least one core discipline (mechanical, electronics, embedded, controls or software) and enough breadth to lead across all of them.
* Experience with prototyping, validation, field trials and the move to manufacturing.
* Familiarity with sensors, navigation, communications and autonomy stacks (a strong plus).
* Exposure to defence, government or other high-reliability product requirements (a plus).
* A Bachelor’s or Master’s in electronics, electrical, mechanical, mechatronics, robotics, aerospace, computer science or a related field.
* Strong systems thinking, sound technical judgment and the discipline to deliver on commitments.

**What Success Looks Like In 180 Days**

* You have reviewed the current new-product pipeline, team capacity, technical risks and key-person dependencies.
* A prioritised new-product portfolio is agreed, with owners, milestones and go/no-go gates.
* At least one priority program has a validated architecture and a working prototype in test.
* A repeatable prototype-to-field-trial-to-handover process is in place.
* A regular review cadence surfaces risks early for the CTO and leadership.

**What This Role Is Not**
It isn’t research detached from delivery, a role where every design decision runs through you, a pure project coordination role without technical ownership, or a firefighting role for existing products.
  
  
**Why join**
You will build the next generation of robotics for some of the harshest environments on earth, work directly with the founders and CTO, and own new products from first sketch to the field.
  
  
**Location**
Kochi, Kerala. Full-time, with travel for trials, customers and partners.

title: Corporate Innovation Lab Leader
description:
At FedTec Reply, we are hiring an Innovation Lab leader to join our team. In this role you will be working on building innovative enablers and accelerators for our federal clients. Our ideal candidate is an inspiring technology leader who is a self-starter, always learning, proactive, and with strong written and verbal communication skills.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Define and lead the vision, roadmap, and delivery standards for FedTec's SaaS and AI-native innovation center, spanning AI transformation, service management, and cybersecurity offerings.
* Design, build, and maintain reusable enablers, accelerators, and reference architectures that reduce cost and time-to-value on federal client engagements.
* Recruit, mentor, and manage a multidisciplinary team of engineers, architects, and consultants, building a culture of innovation and continuous learning.
* Partner with business development and capture teams to shape technical solutions, proposals, and win strategies for federal opportunities.
* Cultivate strategic partnerships with cloud, SaaS, and AI technology vendors to bring emerging capabilities into FedTec's federal offerings.
* Serve as a trusted technical advisor to the firm’s technology leaders, translating mission needs into scalable, secure, AI-enabled solutions.

**Minimum Requirements (Mandatory)**

* 10+ years experience in technology consulting, solution architecture, or IT capability/practice leadership.
* 4 years experience building and leading multidisciplinary engineering or consulting teams.
* Demonstrated experience architecting and delivering SaaS-based or AI-native solutions for enterprise or government clients.
* Working knowledge of federal cybersecurity and compliance frameworks (e.g., NIST RMF, FedRAMP, Zero Trust).
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field from a premier STEM institution.

**Preferred Qualifications (Good To Have)**

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related technical field from a premier STEM institution.
* Experience with hyperscaler cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and modern DevSecOps practices.
* Familiarity with agentic AI, large language models, and AI/ML platform engineering.
* Industry certifications such as AWS or Azure Solutions Architect, ITIL, or CISSP.
* Track record of standing up new practice areas or capability centers from the ground up.

**About Reply**
Reply specializes in the design and implementation of solutions based on new communication channels and digital media. Reply is a network of highly specialized companies supporting global industrial groups operating in the telecom and media, industry and services, banking, insurance and public administration sectors in the definition and development of business models enabled for the new paradigms of AI, cloud computing, digital media and the Internet of Things. title: Project Engineer
description:

**Job Description**
**AVIT Meeting Room**
**Operations L3 Lead**
**Role Overview**
The role leads a technically skilled Level 3 operations team supporting meeting-room devices and connected peripherals. It combines hands-on technical leadership with service management, work allocation, escalation ownership, operational governance, reporting, and continuous improvement. The Lead works closely with monitoring teams, engineering, project teams, onsite support, service desk, platform teams, vendors and technology stakeholders.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**
**Operational Leadership**

* Lead daily L3 operations, balancing incidents, service requests, onboarding and offboarding activities, problem investigations, and improvement work.
* Allocate work based on priority, impact, technical complexity, regional coverage and resource availability.
* Run operational reviews and shift handovers, ensuring ownership, blockers, risks and next actions are clearly documented.
* Maintain effective support coverage and act as the primary operational escalation point for the L3 team.
* Coach team members, strengthen technical capability, and encourage consistent troubleshooting and documentation practices.

**Advanced Incident and Problem Management**

* Provide technical direction for complex meeting-room incidents that cannot be resolved by L1, L2 or monitoring teams.
* Coordinate diagnosis across endpoint, operating system, application, account, network, peripheral and room-integration dependencies.
* Own major or recurring issue progression, bringing together internal resolver groups, engineering teams and vendors as required.
* Ensure incident records include clear technical findings, actions, evidence, workarounds, resolution details and follow-up requirements.
* Drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions for repeat failures, alert noise and avoidable ticket demand.

**Service Reliability and Monitoring**

* Use operational data and monitoring insights to identify device-health risks, recurring alert patterns, estate-wide issues and service degradation.
* Partner with monitoring and engineering teams to improve alert quality, routing, thresholds and actionable diagnostics.
* Track device compliance, connectivity, application and operating-system health, and operational readiness across in-scope platforms.
* Coordinate recovery campaigns and validate that restored devices remain stable after corrective action.

**Device Lifecycle Operations**

* Oversee operational support for meeting-room device onboarding, configuration validation, readiness testing, BAU handover, replacement and offboarding.
* Confirm that prerequisite activities, dependencies, ownership and acceptance criteria are understood before L3 work begins.
* Coordinate with project managers, onsite support and dependent platform teams to resolve gaps affecting deployment or decommissioning.
* Maintain accurate operational records, handover evidence and supporting documentation for lifecycle activities.

**Stakeholder, Vendor and Escalation Management**

* Provide concise updates on service impact, current status, risks, decisions, dependencies and expected next actions.
* Facilitate technical bridges and cross-team troubleshooting for high-impact or multi-domain issues.
* Engage OEMs and support partners for advanced diagnostics, defect investigation, warranty and replacement cases.
* Ensure escalations are evidence-based, assigned to the appropriate owner and progressed until closure or formal handoff.

**Governance, Reporting and Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain and improve standard operating procedures, knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, support boundaries and escalation paths.
* Review service performance, ticket ageing, recurring failure themes, backlog, restoration trends and improvement opportunities.
* Drive automation, monitoring enhancements, self-heal opportunities and ticket-elimination initiatives with measurable outcomes.
* Support operational readiness for new products, platform changes, service transitions and global deployment programmes.
* Promote compliance with change, incident, problem, asset, security and data-handling requirements.

**Technology and Service Environment**
**Area Indicative Environment**
**Meeting-room platforms :**
Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows and Android, Surface Hub, interactive displays, video-conferencing endpoints, room bars, cameras, microphones, speakers, touch panels and room-signage devices
  
  
**Operations tooling :**
ServiceNow, Microsoft Pro Management Portal, monitoring platforms such as Utelogy, Microsoft Intune, reporting dashboards and knowledge repositories
  
  
**Technical domains :**
Windows and Android endpoints, Teams Rooms applications, device accounts, identity and access, networking fundamentals, firmware, drivers, peripherals, remote management and AV signal flow
  
  
**Service practices**
: Incident, request, problem, change, knowledge, asset, vendor, warranty/RMA, onboarding, offboarding and operational reporting
  
  
**Candidate Profile**
**Required Experience And Knowledge**

* Demonstrable experience leading or coordinating advanced AV, unified communications, meeting-room or endpoint operations in an enterprise environment.
* Strong troubleshooting experience across Microsoft Teams Rooms, room peripherals, endpoint operating systems, device management and network dependencies.
* Experience managing complex incidents, technical escalations, vendors and cross-functional resolver teams.

title: Program Manager
description:
We need a hands-on Program Manager who can build and run plans across multiple engineering groups and projects — not a coordinator who only collects status. Will work in Kochi with US-based leadership, persist through ambiguity, and make progress visible when teams do not share a single backlog or manager.

Will use Jira as the system of record and AI to help build, maintain, and report on project and program plans. Comfortable in both Agile delivery and standard project management, and you can present status clearly to executives.

This is a program-level seat: several workstreams, dependencies, and stakeholders. You get into the work — plans, risks, Jira hygiene, follow-through — rather than managing the process from a distance.

**Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain program and project plans: scope, milestones, dependencies, owners, and dates.
* Keep plans current as engineering work moves Use Jira as the live plan.
* Structure epics, versions, and dashboards so status is pulled from the work, not rebuilt in slides.
* Use AI to draft, update, and report on plans while keeping them verified.
* Work across multiple engineering groups and projects.
* Translate between teams that operate differently Chase dependencies and decisions until they land.
* Run a reliable status rhythm.
* Produce executive-ready updates: progress, risks, asks, and what changed Present, do not only email a deck.
* Surface risks early, drive mitigation, and do not drop issues across teams. Tenacious close-the-loop ownership.
* Apply Agile where teams sprint, and standard project management where programs need milestones, gates, and integrated plans. Do not force one method on every workstream.

**Required Qualifications**

* 2+ years' experience managing projects and operating at program level: multiple workstreams, dependencies, and stakeholders — not only a single team sprint board.
* At least 2 years hands-on with Jira. Building and reporting on plans (epics, roadmaps or equivalent, filters, dashboards).
* You configure and maintain the plan; you do not wait for someone else to update tickets.
* Some experience using AI in project management; (build, maintain, and report on project plans, with human review).
* Experienced with Agile delivery and standard project management (schedules, milestones, RAID/risk logs, integrated plans).
* Comfortable with executive presentations and status: concise, current, and clear on asks.Soft skills and working access to operate across groups that are not one org chart.
* Builds trust, gets information, and keeps work moving without formal authority over every team. Hands-on and tenacious.
* Based in Kochi; collaborates with US-based leadership and local engineering teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Technical background in software engineering (or equivalent) — enough to understand delivery, estimates, and dependencies on a Java/SaaS estate.
* Advanced Roadmaps, Structure, Automation, or similar.Confluence for program docs and decision logs.
* PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, or equivalent — credentials do not replace hands-on plan ownership. Healthcare IT, ambulatory, or similarly regulated product delivery.
* Comfortable overlapping US morning for executive status. Or mid-shift (although not required)

**Experience:2+ Years**

**Location: Kochi**

* Track key performance indicators and share regular updates with management.

title: Microservices Architect
description:

- GST – Returns, reconciliations, ITC, notices, assessments and other GST compliance matters.
  
- Relevant provisions of the Companies Act, LLP Act and allied laws affecting audit and financial reporting.
  
- Ability to identify taxation and regulatory issues arising during audit assignments and coordinate their resolution.

- Act as a key point of contact between clients, audit teams and Partners.
  
- Conduct audit planning and closure discussions with client management.
  
- Communicate audit requirements, observations and pending matters professionally and clearly.
  
- Coordinate and communicate, wherever required, with Income Tax, GST and other regulatory authorities.
  
- Maintain strong professional relationships with clients while ensuring independence and audit quality.

- Manage multiple audit and compliance assignments simultaneously.
  
- Work effectively during statutory filing periods, audit seasons and other deadline-driven situations.
  
- Anticipate potential delays and take corrective action through appropriate resource planning.
  
- Escalate critical issues to Partners on a timely basis rather than allowing assignments to exceed committed timelines.
  
- Ensure timely completion without compromising audit quality or documentation.

Experience: Preferably 2–3+ years of relevant experience in a Chartered Accountant firm / audit environment, including meaningful experience in independently handling teams and assignments.

- Proven experience in team handling and leadership.
  
- Strong practical exposure to audits of companies, LLPs and partnership firms.
  
- Sound knowledge of Direct Tax and GST.
  
- Strong understanding of audit procedures and documentation.
  
- Excellent client communication and interpersonal skills.
  
- Ability to communicate professionally with tax and regulatory authorities.

title: General Manager, BibleOn
description:
General Manager, BibleOn

**Location:**
Kochi, Kerala

**Employment:**
Full-time, on-site

**Reporting to:**
Thomson Philip, Co-founder of BibleOn and CEO of Eloit Innovations

**About BibleOn**

BibleOn is a free, ad-free Bible app with a mission to bring the Word of God to people in their own language. Rooted in the Catholic faith and welcoming everyone, BibleOn offers text and audio Scriptures in international, regional and tribal languages, helping individuals and families build a deeper relationship with Jesus through His Word.

Our vision extends beyond an app. We are building a global community of readers, listeners, volunteers, supporters and digital missionaries who help others discover and engage with the Holy Scriptures.

**The Opportunity**

We are seeking an exceptional, mission-driven leader to take full responsibility for leading BibleOn into its next stage of growth.

The General Manager, BibleOn will assume day-to-day leadership from the Co-founder and lead the initiative with independence, sound judgement and accountability. Working within the vision, strategic direction and agreed budgets set with the Co-founder, you will translate that vision into clear priorities, build the right team and deliver measurable results.

This role combines ministry leadership with the discipline of running a growing digital platform. You will lead operations, product priorities, language expansion, content, audience growth, Church partnerships, fundraising and campaigns, working with the existing team and recruiting additional talent as required.

We are looking for someone who can take ownership, make decisions and move the mission forward with limited day-to-day supervision.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Lead the Mission and Strategy**

* Translate BibleOn’s vision into an actionable growth plan with clear milestones, budgets and measures of success.
* Take ownership of execution across the entire initiative, resolving challenges and keeping priorities focused.
* Work closely with the Co-founder on strategic direction, major partnerships and decisions requiring his guidance.
* Provide concise, regular updates on progress, finances, opportunities and matters requiring leadership attention.

**2. Lead Operations and Build the Team**

* Assume responsibility for daily operations and coordinate the existing team across technology, content, languages, outreach and user support.
* Recruit, develop and lead employees, volunteers, language coordinators and external collaborators.
* Establish clear responsibilities, practical workflows and a culture of service, accountability and follow-through.
* Manage budgets, resources and delivery schedules to support sustainable growth.

**3. Expand Languages and Content**

* Develop and execute a plan to expand BibleOn’s text and audio Bible offerings, particularly for underserved language communities.
* Build relationships with Bible publishers, rights holders, translators, recording partners and Church organisations.
* Oversee permissions, content sourcing, production, quality review and publication.
* Develop Scripture-centred content and initiatives that encourage regular Bible reading, listening and spiritual growth.
* Maintain fidelity to Catholic teaching in BibleOn’s original faith content, supported by appropriate theological review.

**4. Grow the Audience and Community**

* Lead user acquisition, engagement and retention across countries and language communities.
* Plan and deliver digital campaigns, parish outreach, community programmes and partnerships.
* Build a network of digital missionaries, volunteers and ambassadors who introduce BibleOn to others.
* Use audience insights and performance data to improve campaigns, content and the user experience.

**5. Build Global Church Relationships**

* Develop active partnerships with dioceses, parishes, religious congregations, Catholic institutions, ministries and lay movements.
* Draw on an established global Catholic network to create opportunities for distribution, language expansion, collaboration and support.
* Represent BibleOn professionally at Church gatherings, conferences and partner meetings.
* Build lasting relationships grounded in trust, service and a shared commitment to spreading the Word of God.

**6. Lead Fundraising and Campaigns**

* Develop and execute a fundraising strategy that supports BibleOn’s free, ad-free mission.
* Build relationships with individual donors, Catholic foundations, institutions and other mission-aligned supporters.
* Lead donation campaigns, sponsorship proposals and supporter communications.
* Establish responsible donor stewardship, with clear reporting on the use of funds and the impact achieved.
* Work with finance and professional advisers on donation processes, financial controls and applicable requirements.

**7. Guide Product Development and User Experience**

* Work with the technology team to prioritise improvements based on mission needs, user feedback and growth opportunities.
* Coordinate product releases, content launches and campaigns.
* Champion accessibility, reliability and ease of use across languages and user groups.
* Monitor adoption, engagement, user support and product performance, turning findings into practical improvements.

**Mandatory Requirements**

* **A practising Catholic**
  , with a personal commitment to prayer, Scripture, the sacramental life and the mission of the Church.
* **An established and active global network within the Catholic Church**
  , with the ability to build trusted relationships across clergy, religious communities, institutions, ministries and lay leaders.
* Proven experience leading an organisation, ministry, business unit or substantial initiative, with responsibility for people, budgets, execution and results.
* The ability to function independently, exercise sound judgement and take full ownership while remaining accountable to the Co-founder’s vision and guidance.
* Strong communication and relationship-building skills, including the ability to present BibleOn’s mission convincingly to partners, donors and communities.
* Willingness to work full-time from Kochi and travel within India and internationally when required.

Experience and Capabilities We Value

* Leadership experience in digital products, technology, Catholic ministry, publishing, media, fundraising or the social impact sector.
* A demonstrated record of growing audiences, communities, partnerships or donor support.
* Experience recruiting and leading multidisciplinary teams, including volunteers and external partners.
* Confidence with budgets, performance metrics, digital campaigns and project delivery.
* Experience working across languages, cultures and international networks.
* A relevant degree or equivalent professional experience. An MBA or postgraduate qualification is an advantage.

**What Success Looks Like**

* BibleOn operates effectively under your leadership, with the Co-founder able to focus on strategic guidance.
* The team has clear priorities, defined responsibilities and consistent delivery.
* More people discover BibleOn, return regularly and engage deeply with Scripture.
* New language communities gain access to quality text and audio Bible content.
* Church partnerships generate active collaboration and measurable reach.
* Donations and supporter relationships provide a stronger foundation for the mission.
* BibleOn grows while remaining faithful to its Catholic identity and free, ad-free purpose.

**Who Will Thrive in This Role**

You combine a heart for evangelisation with the ability to build and lead. You are comfortable developing strategy, meeting a bishop, presenting to a donor, guiding a team and following through on practical details.

* You see bringing the Word of God to more people as a personal calling, and you have the leadership ability to turn that commitment into sustained action.

title: Learning Deployment Specialist

**Job Summary**
:
  
  
Talent Services is a core service function within the Global Delivery Services organization, providing multiple HR and learning related support services including Recruitment support, Onboarding support, People Data Administration, Learning Administration, Cross Border Travel, Global Mobility and Performance Management support to EY member firms.
  
  
Talent Services supports Europe West (EW) as part of the extended Region Learning team. It is fully integrated with onshore colleagues in Europe West and participates in meetings, projects and planning activities as part of one team. It is aligned with the Learning Global Process Model and initiates learning processes through the existing workflow for execution by the CAT and DAT teams.
  
  
The person selected for this role will be at the rank of
**Senior Associate**
and will be responsible for the deployment of multiple courses within one or more curricula for
**Europe West**
, working alongside the Senior Deployment Specialist and/or Learning Program Manager. The Senior Associate will oversee learning administration activities and report on course feedback. (50%)
  
  
The Senior Associate will support the end-to-end program lifecycle, including program planning, stakeholder coordination, participant and facilitator management, communications, learning logistics, program documentation, delivery readiness, evaluation, and continuous improvement. (50%)

: SuccessFactors (Learning Management System), ServiceNow
  
  
**Essential Functions Of The Job (Responsibilities)**
**Deployment (0.5 FTE)**

* Ensure end-to-end coordination of learning deployment activities, including validating training request forms, submitting item and class requests, and ensuring that CE credits are awarded.
* Submit requests for online, virtual, and physical classroom sessions, as well as program requests in SuccessFactors for learner consumption.
* Address learner queries related to credits, class requests, and compliance.
* Monitor participant nominations and manage cancellations, no-shows and missed sessions.
* Monitor and analyse reports, including credit reports, NASBA reports and evaluation feedback.
* Ensure CE credits are awarded to learning participants and instructors, where applicable.
* Build and maintain close working relationships with the EW Learning team.

* Coordinate the planning and delivery of Europe West Tax learning programs, including timelines, action trackers, governance activities and key deliverables.
* Manage participant, facilitator and stakeholder engagement activities, including nominations, communications, briefing activities and delivery readiness.
* Support stakeholder meetings and governance forums, including agenda preparation, documentation, action tracking and follow-up.
* Maintain program documentation, status reports, trackers and learning resources.
* Support virtual and face-to-face learning events, including learner experience, logistics coordination and delivery support.
* Monitor risks, dependencies and program actions, escalating issues where appropriate.
* Analyse participant and stakeholder feedback, evaluate program outcomes and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Build and maintain strong working relationships with business stakeholders, facilitators and learning teams across Europe West.

**Knowledge and Skills Requirements**
:
  
  
**Deployment**

* Understanding of EY and EY Talent.
* Stakeholder management.
* Strong IT skills in the Microsoft Office 365 suite, including Teams, Excel, Power BI, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook and SharePoint.
* Strong written and oral communication skills and the ability to work effectively with multiple stakeholders across the organisation at all levels.
* Strong team player with an enthusiastic, can-do approach and the ability to coordinate and work as ‘one team’.
* Drive the delivery of quality services and products to Talent.
* Ability to learn new processes and skills quickly.
* Proactive problem solver with a solution-oriented mindset.
* Flexible and dependable; willing to adjust the work schedule as necessary to meet peak demands and customer requirements.

**Program Management**
:
  
  

* Strong program coordination and organizational skills.
* Strong program coordination, organizational and prioritization skills.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with senior business stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines and competing demands simultaneously.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving and attention-to-detail skills.
* Ability to interpret learning metrics, feedback and program data to support decision-making and continuous improvement.
* Ability to think creatively and identify opportunities to enhance the learner experience.
* Proficiency in Microsoft 365 tools, including Teams, SharePoint, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook; advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills are desirable.
* Ability to work effectively across countries, cultures and time zones.
* Learner and client-service focused, with a proactive and solution-oriented mindset.

**Job Requirements**
:
  
  
**Education**
:
  
  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in human resources, Business or a related discipline.

**Experience**
:
  
  
**Deployment**

* 5 to 8 years of relevant experience.
* Significant experience working in HR within a professional services or corporate environment.
* Experience working in Learning and Development is desirable.
* Experience working in international and diverse environments.

**Program Management**

* 5-8 years of experience in Learning & Development, Talent, Program Management, People Development, or a related field.
* Experience supporting the planning and delivery of learning programs, talent initiatives, or business projects.
* Experience supporting regional or global initiatives within a matrix and stakeholder-driven environment.
* Experience working with senior stakeholders and managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Experience coordinating virtual and/or classroom learning events, workshops, or development programs.
* Experience collaborating with geographically dispersed and cross-functional teams.
* Experience in professional services and/or international environments is desirable.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

title: Senior MES Delivery Lead
description:
**Job Description**
The Senior MES Delivery Lead will work closely with Operations, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Automation, IT, Data Backbone teams, and external technology partners to drive MES adoption and support manufacturing transformation initiatives. Responsibilities include process analysis, requirements engineering, workshop facilitation, solution evaluation, architecture collaboration, implementation support, deployment planning, testing, documentation, and continuous improvement activities.
  
  
The successful candidate will act as a subject matter expert for MES and digital manufacturing systems, helping to define future-state manufacturing processes, support Smart Factory initiatives, and contribute to the long-term development of SPS's manufacturing technology landscape. As the program evolves, the role is expected to progress toward ownership of MES strategy, deployment activities, and future capability development within the organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead and support MES implementation, deployment, and scaling activities across SPS manufacturing sites globally.
* Analyse manufacturing processes and identify opportunities for digitalisation, automation, process optimisation, and operational improvements.
* Gather, define, structure, and maintain business, functional, technical, and architectural requirements for MES and related manufacturing systems.
* Develop and maintain manufacturing use cases, business scenarios, process flows, and solution evaluation criteria.
* Facilitate workshops with Operations, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Planning, Automation, IT, and business stakeholders to capture requirements and align solution designs.
* Evaluate MES modules and capabilities against business needs, technology architecture, integration requirements, scalability, and long-term sustainability objectives.
* Contribute to solution architecture design involving MES, ERP, PLM, SCADA, PLC, Historian, APS, and related manufacturing systems.
* Support integration planning and coordination between enterprise platforms and manufacturing systems to ensure effective information flow across the manufacturing environment.
* Participate in system testing, validation activities, deployment planning, issue resolution, and implementation support throughout project lifecycles.
* Collaborate closely with Smart Factory, Data Backbone, Automation, Quality, Engineering, Operations, IT teams, and external technology vendors.
* Prepare documentation including requirements specifications, process maps, evaluation reports, implementation plans, testing documentation, and deployment materials.
* Support decision-making processes through technical analysis, solution recommendations, and business case development.
* Promote best practices in digital manufacturing, Industry 4.0, Smart Factory solutions, and manufacturing system governance.
* Take ownership of assigned initiatives and drive activities through completion while effectively communicating progress, risks, dependencies, and recommendations to stakeholders.
* Contribute to the development of future MES capabilities and support the growth of SPS's digital manufacturing competency.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, Automation Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Master's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing Systems, Industrial Automation, Information Technology, or a related field is preferred.
* Minimum 10 years of experience in Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), manufacturing systems, industrial digitalisation, Smart Factory initiatives, or related disciplines.
* Demonstrated experience leading or supporting end-to-end MES implementation, deployment, and rollout projects within manufacturing environments.
* Strong understanding of MES integration with ERP, PLC, SCADA, Historian, APS, PLM, Quality Management Systems, and related manufacturing technologies.
* Experience conducting manufacturing process mapping, business analysis, requirements gathering, workshop facilitation, and solution evaluation activities.
* Good understanding of enterprise architecture and manufacturing system architecture principles.
* Ability to work effectively across Operations, Engineering, Quality, IT, and business stakeholder groups.
* Experience working within manufacturing environments and a strong understanding of shopfloor operations and production processes.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills.
* Experience with MES platforms such as AVEVA, Critical Manufacturing, Siemens Opcenter, Rockwell FactoryTalk, Proficy, or similar solutions is preferred.
* Experience supporting global or multi-site manufacturing deployments is highly desirable.
* Exposure to Industry 4.0, Industrial Data Backbone, Unified Namespace (UNS), MQTT, Industrial Historian platforms, or related technologies is advantageous.
* Experience within engineer-to-order, project-based, high-mix, batch, continuous, or other complex manufacturing environments is preferred.
* Demonstrates ownership, leadership, and a proactive approach to driving initiatives, managing stakeholders, and delivering business outcomes.
* Strong collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively in international and cross-functional teams.
* Willingness to travel internationally, including visits to Denmark, Brazil, the UK, and other SPS manufacturing locations as required.

**About Us**
Every day, the oil and gas industry’s best minds put more than 150 years of experience to work to help our customers achieve lasting success.
  
  
**We Power the Industry that Powers the World**
Throughout every region in the world and across every area of drilling and production, our family of companies has provided the technical expertise, advanced equipment, and operational support necessary for success—now and in the future.

**Service Above All**
This drives us to anticipate our customers’ needs and work with them to deliver the finest products and services on time and on budget.

title: Software Verification & Testing Lead
description:
We are seeking an experienced Software Verification & Testing Lead to lead software verification, validation, and quality assurance activities for medical device and connected healthcare applications.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have strong experience in software testing methodologies, test automation, requirement traceability, defect management, and regulatory compliance. The role involves ensuring the reliability, safety, security, and performance of embedded software, mobile applications, cloud platforms, and integrated medical device systems.
  
  
‍
  
  
**Key Competencies**

* Strong understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC).
* Hands-on experience in manual and automated software testing.
* Experience with test automation tools such as Selenium, Appium, Playwright, or equivalent frameworks.
* Proficiency in Python or another scripting language for test automation.
* Strong experience in API testing using Postman, REST Assured, or similar tools.
* Experience in integration testing, system testing, regression testing, and defect management.
* Familiarity with test management and defect tracking tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or TestRail.
* Knowledge of Linux environments, networking fundamentals, and database testing.
* Experience preparing test plans, test cases, test execution reports, and requirement traceability matrices.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and team management skills.

‍
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Software Verification & Validation
  
  

* Lead end-to-end software verification and validation activities across the software development lifecycle.
* Develop and execute test strategies, test plans, test cases, and verification protocols based on software requirements.
* Perform functional, integration, system, regression, and performance testing.
* Ensure complete requirement-to-test traceability and maintain verification documentation.
* Review software requirements and design specifications to ensure testability and compliance.
* Identify, document, track, and resolve software defects in collaboration with development teams.

Test Automation & Technical Testing
  
  

* Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks to improve test coverage and efficiency.
* Perform API testing, database validation, and end-to-end application testing.
* Validate data communication and integration between wearable devices, mobile applications, backend services, and cloud platforms.
* Test real-time data acquisition, transmission, processing, and visualization.
* Perform reliability testing, including connectivity interruptions, data loss, recovery, and error-handling scenarios.
* Integrate automated tests with CI/CD pipelines where applicable.

Medical Device Quality & Compliance
  
  

* Support software verification and validation activities in accordance with applicable medical device standards.
* Maintain verification evidence, test reports, defect records, and traceability matrices.
* Participate in risk-based testing and verification of safety-critical software functions.
* Support design reviews, quality audits, and regulatory documentation.
* Collaborate with quality assurance and regulatory teams to ensure compliance with applicable requirements.

Team Leadership & Coordination
  
  

* Lead and mentor software verification and testing engineers.
* Assign testing activities, monitor progress, and ensure timely completion of verification milestones.
* Coordinate with software developers, embedded engineers, system architects, and product teams.
* Review test deliverables and communicate testing status, risks, and quality metrics to stakeholders.
* Drive continuous improvements in testing processes, automation, and software quality.

‍
