title: Founding Food Sourcing & Export Operations Executive – Spices, Dry Fruits & Grains
description:
Founding Food Sourcing & Export Operations Executive – Spices, Dry Fruits & Grains
  
  
Company: HALBEX Private Limited
  
Location:Kochi / location to be finalised
  
Work Mode: On-site
  
Employment Type: Full-time
  
  
About HALBEX
  
  
HALBEX is building a B2B international export marketplace focused exclusively on halal FMCG food products sourced from India and supplied to international buyers.
  
  
We follow a merchant-trader model in which HALBEX manages the commercial transaction between Indian suppliers and international buyers, coordinating product compliance, seller onboarding, export documentation, and logistics.
  
  
We are currently in the pre-launch stage, preparing for our planned commercial launch in March 2027.
  
  
About the Role
  
  
We are looking for a hands-on professional to join HALBEX's founding team and help build our food sourcing and export operations from the ground up.
  
  
The first priority is to identify reliable Indian farmers, FPOs, processors, millers, and suppliers who can provide export-quality spices, dry fruits, and grains at competitive prices.
  
  
The selected candidate will work directly with the founder and gradually establish the supplier network, product onboarding processes, compliance data, logistics partnerships, and shipment execution workflow required for HALBEX.
  
  
This is a founding-stage role requiring practical execution, independent research, supplier coordination, and ownership of day-to-day operational tasks.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
1. Supplier Sourcing & Price Comparison
  
  
- Identify major sourcing regions for spices, dry fruits, and grains across India.
  
- Find and contact farmers, FPOs, processors, millers, and export-ready suppliers.
  
- Collect comparable quotations and evaluate prices, quality, MOQ, production capacity, packaging, and delivery timelines.
  
- Identify competitive suppliers while ensuring products meet the required quality and export standards.
  
- Build and maintain a verified supplier database.
  
  
2. Product Development & Seller Onboarding
  
  
- Collect supplier company documents and product specifications.
  
- Verify product details, packaging sizes, weights, supply capacity, and export readiness.
  
- Coordinate supplier registration and product listing on HALBEX.
  
- Ensure required information and documents are collected before product approval.
  
  
3. Product-Country Compliance Data
  
  
- Research applicable food-export requirements using official government and regulatory sources.
  
- Develop structured compliance records for each priority product and destination country.
  
- Identify applicable certificates, testing requirements, labelling rules, restrictions, and supporting evidence.
  
- Record source references, verification status, and responsible parties.
  
- Coordinate with the founder and technology team to implement the verified requirements in the platform.
  
  
4. Logistics Vendor Onboarding
  
  
- Identify freight forwarders, customs brokers, shipping partners, and other relevant logistics providers.
  
- Collect and compare freight quotations.
  
- Establish procedures for shipment planning, documentation, and logistics coordination.
  
  
5. Buyer Order & Shipment Execution
  
  
- Coordinate supplier confirmation, product availability, compliance approval, and shipment planning.
  
- Support buyer orders and export documentation.
  
- Coordinate the complete process from supplier selection to delivery.
  
- Help execute HALBEX's first commercial export shipment through the online platform.
  
  
Initial Six-Month Roadmap
  
  
Month Main target
  
  
November 2026 Research sourcing regions and identify competitive suppliers
  
December 2026 Verify suppliers, collect product data, begin seller onboarding and compliance research
  
January 2027 Expand product compliance data and onboard logistics vendors
  
February 2027 Test the end-to-end order and shipment workflow
  
March 2027 Support buyer onboarding and work towards the first commercial shipment
  
April 2027 Review operations, improve processes, and expand the supplier network
  
  
  
These are proposed targets and will be finalised according to operational readiness and available resources.
  
  
Required Experience
  
  
- Experience in food-product sourcing, agricultural commodities, spices, dry fruits, grains, or food exports.
  
- Practical experience identifying and negotiating with suppliers.
  
- Understanding of product specifications, quality requirements, pricing, and supply capacity.
  
- Familiarity with export documentation and international logistics.
  
- Ability to research regulatory requirements and maintain accurate records.
  
- Strong communication, negotiation, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
  
- Willingness to work hands-on in an early-stage startup.
  
  
Preference will be given to candidates with direct experience in spices, dry fruits, grains, agricultural commodities, and export-oriented food sourcing.
  
  
Who Should Apply?
  
  
This opportunity is suitable for someone who wants to build a new export operation rather than simply manage an established logistics department.
  
  
The selected candidate will initially work directly with the founder and take ownership of supplier discovery, product onboarding, compliance coordination, and logistics execution. The team will expand as HALBEX grows.
  
  
Application
  
  
Please apply with your CV and briefly describe:
  
  
1. The food or agricultural products you have sourced or handled.
  
2. The regions or supplier networks you know.
  
3. Your experience negotiating prices and evaluating suppliers.
  
4. Your export documentation and logistics experience.
  
5. Your availability to join a pre-launch startup.

title: Senior Project Coordinator
description:
**Who we are**

White Rabbit Group is a company that partners with world-class agencies for web and mobile app development and design, letting our customers focus on what they do best, while we focus on building. We work across a broad spectrum of technologies including PHP, React, Node, Strapi, Shopify, WordPress, and fully native and hybrid mobile apps. With nearly 100 full-time employees across the US, Colombia, and India, we collaborate closely to bring our customers’ visions to life—and have fun doing it!

**What we're looking for**

White Rabbit Group is seeking a Project Coordinator who combines strong project execution capabilities with exceptional organisational and stakeholder management skills. In this role, you will be responsible for orchestrating the end-to-end delivery of multiple projects, ensuring teams remain aligned, risks are proactively managed, and commitments are delivered with quality and predictability. You will work closely with engineering teams, designers, clients, and business stakeholders, acting as both a delivery facilitator and an advocate for efficient execution.

**Responsibilities**

* Take ownership of the successful delivery of multiple projects, ensuring outcomes are achieved within agreed timelines, scope, budget, and quality expectations.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to define project goals, delivery milestones, success criteria, and execution plans.

* Provide regular and transparent updates to stakeholders through status reports, dashboards, reviews, and delivery communications.
* Monitor project progress and conduct routine assessments to identify risks, dependencies, bottlenecks, and delivery challenges.

* Foster collaboration between Engineering, QA, UI/UX, TechOps, and business teams to ensure smooth execution and alignment.

* Drive accountability, predictability, and continuous improvement within delivery processes.
* Identify opportunities to streamline workflows, improve operational efficiency, and introduce delivery best practices.

* Lead objective, data-driven discussions that support informed decision-making and successful project outcomes.
* Balance multiple initiatives effectively while maintaining strong organisational discipline and attention to detail.

**Qualifications**

* 3+ years of experience in Project Coordination, Project Management, Delivery Management, or Scrum Master roles within software delivery environments.
* Proven experience managing multiple web and mobile projects simultaneously using Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery methodologies.

* Health insurance
* Employee Well-being & Assistance Program

title: Client Performance Strategist
description:
**Job description:**

We are looking for a hands-on Senior SEO & Client Performance Strategist to join our team. In this critical, client-facing role, you will act as a "first responder" for underperforming SEO accounts. You will be responsible for diagnosing performance gaps, validating data integrity, and creating high-impact recovery roadmaps.

Key Responsibilities

* **Performance Monitoring:**
  Conduct monthly performance reviews for assigned SEO clients, focusing deeply on those classified as "Caution" or "Underperforming".1
* **Data Validation:**
  Ensure data accuracy across platforms (e.g., GA4, Google Search Console, CRM, and call-tracking) to distinguish between genuine performance issues and measurement discrepancies.
* **Root-Cause Diagnosis:**
  Investigate underperformance across technical SEO, conversion paths, and broader business factors (e.g., budget changes, seasonality, or client operations).
* **Strategic Planning:**
  Develop practical improvement plans that prioritize high-impact actions. You will maintain an action tracker to ensure accountability, tracking progress and blocking issues until resolution.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:**
  Partner with Account Managers to provide clear, actionable performance narratives to clients. You will work across delivery teams (Content, Dev, PPC, etc.) to implement necessary changes.
* **Process Improvement:**
  Identify recurring issues to develop diagnostic checklists, recovery playbooks, and training materials, contributing to the overall quality standards of the agency.

What You Bring

* **Experience:**
  5+ years of SEO experience, ideally within a digital marketing agency.1
* **Technical Expertise:**
  Advanced knowledge of technical, on-page, local, and off-page SEO, plus content strategy.
* **Analytical Skills:**
  Strong proficiency in tools like Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, Semrush, and Screaming Frog, with a demonstrated ability to evaluate complex CRM and call-tracking data.
* **Strategic Thinking:**
  Exceptional root-cause analysis and commercial judgment, with the ability to translate findings into clear, prioritized recommendations.
* **Communication:**
  Strong written and verbal communication skills; the ability to influence cross-functional teams and stakeholders without direct managerial authority.

title: Show Producer
description:
**Company Description**
Ginger Media Entertainments Pvt Ltd combines entertainment media and strategic digital marketing to create impactful brand stories and engaging content. Founded in 2013, it has become one of Kerala’s leading media platforms, known for celebrity interviews, entertainment programs, and original digital content. The company’s channels host popular shows like “Choych Choych Pokam,” “Kochu Kochu Santhoshangal,” and “Nna Than Buzzer Adi Show,” reaching millions of viewers across YouTube and social media. Alongside entertainment, Ginger Media offers full-service digital marketing solutions, including content creation, video production, brand strategy, and influencer collaborations. With a strong audience base on YouTube, Facebook, and Instagram, the team focuses on helping brands and creators connect with the right audience through creativity, authenticity, and innovation.

**Role Description**
The Show Producer will oversee end-to-end production of entertainment shows, from concept development and scripting to recording, post-production, and final delivery. This full-time role is on-site in Kochi and involves coordinating with hosts, technical crews, and talent to ensure smooth execution of studio and field recordings. Daily responsibilities include planning show formats, managing production schedules, supervising video and audio quality, and ensuring content aligns with the channel’s brand, audience expectations, and platform best practices. The Show Producer will collaborate with the digital marketing team to optimize content for social media, manage episode releases, and support promotional campaigns. The role also requires problem-solving on set, maintaining production budgets and timelines, and continuously improving show quality based on audience feedback and performance data.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Broadcasting, with experience in managing or coordinating show formats.
* Candidates should possess Writing skills for scripts, show outlines, intros, outros, and promotional copy.
* Relevant additional qualifications include strong organizational and time-management abilities, attention to detail, and the capacity to handle multiple productions simultaneously.
* Experience in entertainment, media production, or digital content creation is highly beneficial, especially with YouTube or social media-based shows.
* A diploma or degree in Media Studies, Mass Communication, Film, Broadcasting, or a related field is preferred, or equivalent practical experience.
* Ability to work collaboratively with creative, technical, and marketing teams, and flexibility to work occasional evenings or weekends based on production needs.

+ Review reports, schedules, and supporting workpapers for the firm’s partnership, state, and other tax filings.

* Bachelor’s degree in accounting or related field
* CPA with 5+ years of experience in federal tax compliance, planning and consulting at a public accounting firm with a focus on high-net-worth individuals, partnerships, and closely held businesses
* Experience reviewing complex Forms 1040 returns, partnership and flow-through reporting, and supervising tax compliance workflows within a public accounting environment
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate across global teams

**Additionally, The Following Qualifications Are Preferred**

* Master’s degree in accounting or related field
* Experience with multi-state tax compliance
* Proven ability to manage, mentor and develop staff
* Experience working with US-based public accounting firms in a global delivery environment

Location: Irumpanam, Ernakulam, Kerala

Department: Civil Engineering / Project Execution

Employment Type: Full-time, Site-based

About the Role

We are looking for a technically competent and result-oriented Civil Site Engineer to join our railway infrastructure project at Irumpanam, Kerala. The candidate will be responsible for supervising site execution, ensuring quality and safety standards, monitoring work progress, maintaining project documentation, and coordinating with railway officials, consultants, subcontractors, and material suppliers.

The ideal candidate should have practical experience in civil construction and the ability to manage site activities independently while maintaining compliance with approved drawings, technical specifications, and Indian Railways requirements.

Key Responsibilities

\* Supervise and execute civil construction activities in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, and project schedules.

\* Manage reinforced cement concrete (RCC), plain cement concrete (PCC), concrete pavement (CC), reinforcement steel, excavation, earthwork, and structural works.

\* Coordinate dismantling and reconstruction of catwalks, permanent way (P.Way) activities, and associated railway infrastructure works.

\* Monitor daily labour deployment, machinery utilisation, material consumption, and work productivity.

\* Prepare and maintain measurement books (MBs), quantity statements, daily progress reports (DPRs), and records required for running account (RA) bills.

\* Maintain site registers, including cement, steel, cube testing, excavation, attendance, and hindrance registers.

\* Coordinate concrete sampling, cube testing, material inspections, soil testing, and other required quality-control procedures.

\* Ensure proper reinforcement inspection, shuttering checks, concrete placement, curing, and quality documentation.

\* Identify site hindrances, drawing discrepancies, pending approvals, and work-front constraints; report them promptly with supporting records.

\* Coordinate with railway engineering officials for site inspections, measurements, approvals, work permissions, and execution requirements.

\* Monitor construction progress against planned targets and proactively resolve execution-related issues.

\* Ensure compliance with site safety requirements, railway working protocols, and applicable technical specifications.

\* Maintain accurate records of materials received, consumed, and balance quantities at the site.

Eligibility Criteria

\* Diploma or B.Tech/B.E. in Civil Engineering.

\* Relevant experience in civil construction, infrastructure projects, or railway works.

\* Working knowledge of RCC, PCC, CC pavement, reinforcement detailing, quantity estimation, and construction measurements.

\* Familiarity with BOQs, technical specifications, RA billing, and site documentation.

\* Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and coordinate with project stakeholders.

\* Proficiency in MS Excel and basic project reporting tools.

\* Strong site-management, problem-solving, communication, and coordination skills.

Preferred: Experience in Indian Railways projects, railway yards, P.Way-related civil works, government infrastructure contracts, or construction projects involving formal inspection and billing procedures.

What We Expect

We are looking for an engineer who takes ownership of site execution, maintains accurate documentation, identifies issues before they affect progress, and ensures that work is completed safely, efficiently, and to the required quality standards.

Interested candidates: Apply through LinkedIn or share your CV, relevant project experience, current location, notice period, and salary expectations.

**Associate Director**
ITS (Internal Transformation Services) under EY’s Enablement Service, is a team of seasoned Enablement Services professionals that operate globally on internal transformation programs which are critical to EY’s strategy and ambition. Our expertise is in the areas of Project Management, Strategy, Technology, Process Improvement, Organization Design, and Organizational Change Management.
  
  
**Job Description:**
We are seeking a highly experienced and knowledgeable Business Consultant to join our dynamic team. ITS professionals should be able to operate globally on internal programs that are critical to EY’s strategy and ambition. As a Business Consultant, you will play a pivotal role in providing strategic guidance and expert advice to our Executive Leadership in the areas of project management, change management, and design thinking. Your extensive experience in these fields will be invaluable as you collaborate with cross-functional teams, lead transformative projects, and drive organizational growth and innovation. The ideal candidate possesses a deep understanding of project management methodologies, change management principles, and design thinking frameworks, along with exceptional leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Collaborate with Executive Leadership to understand their business objectives, challenges, and opportunities. Strong leadership skills with the ability to influence and guide teams toward successful outcomes
* Manage & engage senior stakeholder relationships at CxO, Partner, Functional Head levels
* Perform rapid assessment of landscape for stakeholders and provide insights to accelerate action towards refining their current state
* Bring diverse and thought-provoking perspective to transformations, including market trends, new and innovative ideas to drive data driven decision making
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a strategic mindset and attention to detail
* Drive and build upon a culture of continuous improvement by developing innovative idea
* Conduct comprehensive analyses of organization’s processes and systems
* Provide strategic recommendations and action plans to drive business performance and transformation
* Develop roadmaps for implementing project management, Organizational change management, and design thinking initiatives.
* Lead and manage complex projects from initiation to closure, ensuring timely delivery and quality outcomes
* Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, and success criteria in collaboration with clients and stakeholders
* Monitor project progress, identify risks and issues, and implement mitigation strategies
* Foster effective communication and collaboration among project teams and stakeholders
* Develop and implement change management strategies to support organizational transformation initiatives
* Conducting Change Impact Analysis and Change Readiness / Gap Assessment and give recommendations that are actionable on immediate and long-term basis
* Build strong change network, drive change adoption, manage stakeholders with people centric approach, if needed work towards mindset shift and achieve cultural transformation
* Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of change management efforts and make adjustments as necessary
* Apply design thinking principles and methodologies to identify innovative solutions to complex business problems
* Conduct user research, gather insights, and define user personas and journeys.
* Advocate for design thinking principles and foster a culture of creativity and experimentation within client organizations
* Contribute to the development and enhancement of consulting methodologies and frameworks
* Mentor and coach junior consultants, providing guidance and support in their professional growth

**What will make you eligible for this role?**

* Master’s degree in business administration, management, or a related field
* 15+ years of experience with at least 10+ years of management / business consulting experience
* Advance MS Suite skills – particularly, to develop engaging presentations and dashboards
* Professional certifications such as PMP (Project Management Professional), certification in Change Management or Design Thinking are highly desirable.
* Deep understanding of project management methodologies (e.g., Agile, Waterfall) and their practical application in different contexts.
* Extensive knowledge of change management principles, models, and methodologies, with hands-on experience leading change initiatives.
* Proficiency in design thinking frameworks and tools, with the ability to apply them effectively to solve complex business problems.
* Awareness and experience of leveraging technology as enablers
* Exceptional communication, presentation skills with the ability to tailor messages to diverse audiences

**Good to have**

* Experience working in the Big 4 professional services firms and other global management consultancies is highly desirable
* MBA or equivalent advanced education is preferable
* Certification in Project Management, Organisational Change Management, Design Thinking, Facilitation will be an advantage

**What working at EY offers?**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you
* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around

* Conduct stakeholder workshops and document as-is and to-be billing processes, requirements, pain points, controls and business rules.
* Translate business requirements into functional designs, user stories, configuration requirements, interface requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Support billing transformation decisions covering platform consolidation, legacy modernization, product and pricing migration, integration rationalization and phased decommissioning.
* Define and review migration requirements for customer accounts, billing accounts, products, services, balances, open items and billing history.
* Support data mapping, cleansing, reconciliation, mock migration, parallel billing, cutover and post-migration validation activities.
* Define and deliver solution designs, interface specifications, test strategies, test cases and migration-reconciliation reports for billing completeness and accuracy.
* Support system integration testing, end-to-end testing, user acceptance testing, bill validation, cutover rehearsals and production support.

* 4–8 years of experience in telecom BSS, with significant techno-functional, hands-on experience in billing and revenue management.
* Hands-on experience with at least one major billing platform such as Aria Billing Cloud, Ericsson Billing, Netcracker Revenue Management or an equivalent platform. Hands-on experience on Aria Billing will be a definitive advantage.
* Strong understanding of the telecom billing lifecycle, including customer and billing-account management, product and pricing configuration, usage processing, rating, recurring and one-time charges, bill calculation, invoicing, taxation, payments, adjustments, collections and dunning.
* Hands-on proficiency in Java, XML, SQL, APIs, data-analysis tools and cloud environments is required.
* Should be willing to work in shifts

* Identify opportunities for account growth, reusable assets, accelerators, and follow-on transformation initiatives.

* Promote engineering excellence, knowledge sharing, reusable patterns, continuous improvement, and responsible use of data and AI.
* Contribute to hiring, workforce planning, communities of practice, thought leadership, and organisational capability development.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* Typically 15+ years of technology experience, including substantial experience delivering enterprise data programmes and operating in a lead data or solution architecture capacity.
* Demonstrable ownership of large, complex, multi-team programmes with responsibility for delivery governance, senior stakeholders, budgets, quality, and commercial outcomes.
* Strong experience designing and delivering cloud data platforms on Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud; deep expertise in at least one ecosystem is essential.
* Proven experience with modern data platforms and technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Synapse Analytics, Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, Kafka, cloud object storage, and modern BI tools.
* Advanced knowledge of SQL and strong working understanding of Python or PySpark, data integration, distributed processing, DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and observability.
* Solid command of data modelling, metadata management, data quality, master data management, governance, privacy, security, and lifecycle management.

* Excellent executive communication, consulting, negotiation, facilitation, decision-making, and conflict-resolution skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Cloud architecture or data engineering certification in Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, or Snowflake certification.

* Platform reliability, performance, security, data quality, observability, and unit-cost improvement.
* Stakeholder confidence, client satisfaction, benefits realisation, and successful adoption of delivered capabilities.
* Team engagement, capability growth, predictable staffing, and development of future technical and delivery leaders.
* Commercial performance, pipeline contribution, and expansion of trusted client relationships.

At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.

description:
**Job Title**
Project Planner
  
  
**Job Description Summary**
The Project Planner will be responsible for developing, monitoring, and controlling project schedules for large-scale hotel, resort, and hospitality construction projects. The role will ensure effective planning, progress tracking, resource optimization, and timely project delivery while supporting project leadership with accurate forecasting and reporting.

* Develop, maintain, and monitor integrated project schedules for construction projects from design through handover.

* Coordinate with project managers, consultants, architects, contractors, and stakeholders to ensure alignment of project milestones and deliverables.
* Track project performance against baseline schedules, identify delays and risks, and recommend recovery plans and mitigation strategies.
* Generate periodic progress reports, dashboards, earned value analysis, and executive presentations to support project decision-making.
* Review contractor schedules, evaluate extension of time (EOT) claims, and monitor compliance with contractual project timelines.
* Support cost and project controls teams through schedule integration, forecasting, and planning-related analyses.

**About You**

* Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 6 years of relevant experience in project planning and scheduling for commercial construction projects.
* Strong expertise in MS Project, project controls, critical path methodology (CPM), and project scheduling techniques.
* Proven experience in managing complex hospitality development projects from concept/design stage through construction and commissioning.
* Excellent analytical, reporting, stakeholder management, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Knowledge of construction contracts, claims management, risk assessment, and project control best practices.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment with multiple stakeholders and project teams.

Why Join Us?
  
  

* Opportunity to work on prestigious hotel, resort, and hospitality developments across diverse locations.

title: Senior OT & IT Data Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
The Senior OT/IT Data Specialist will support the design, implementation, operation, and continuous improvement of the Smart Factory Data Backbone platform. This role bridges industrial automation, OT/IT networking, industrial data engineering, and modern software platforms. The successful candidate will support integration of shop-floor equipment and OT systems with edge, enterprise IT, and cloud services while ensuring industrial data is secure, reliable, well-governed, and fit for downstream applications.
  
  
This is a senior, hands-on technical role that combines architecture support, technical delivery, platform troubleshooting, vendor coordination, stakeholder collaboration, data governance, and operational support across manufacturing locations. The role will work closely with architects, engineers, lifecycle teams, system integrators, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable smart factory solutions and support future digital manufacturing initiatives.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Participate in site-level architecture design activities across manufacturing locations and support implementation of the Smart Factory Data Backbone platform.
* Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Data Backbone infrastructure, including Kubernetes/OpenShift-based edge deployments.
* Integrate industrial equipment, PLCs, and OT systems using industrial protocols such as Siemens S7, OPC UA, MQTT, and similar connectivity technologies.
* Troubleshoot OT/IT networking issues including TCP/IP, routing, NAT, firewalls, DNS, certificates, and edge-to-cloud connectivity.
* Build, support, and maintain industrial data pipelines, messaging solutions, and integration architectures using technologies such as Litmus, MQTT, and OPC UA.
* Develop and maintain industrial data models to contextualize machine, asset, and time-series data for downstream applications and analytics.
* Perform data validation and troubleshooting across the complete machine-to-cloud data flow, including equipment, network, edge platform, data pipeline, and database/cloud environments to ensure data quality, accuracy, and reliability.
* Support technical acceptance testing of vendor solutions following deployment and contribute to Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) activities.
* Support IT/OT risk assessments related to the Smart Factory Data Backbone platform and connected manufacturing systems.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of data governance standards, documentation, tag naming conventions, and tag enablement processes.
* Produce and maintain technical documentation including system designs, technical procedures, configuration guides, governance documentation, and operational support materials.
* Collaborate closely with architects, lifecycle teams, software developers, data engineers, system integrators, vendors, and manufacturing stakeholders to support successful project delivery.
* Support system enhancements, upgrades, troubleshooting activities, and continuous improvement initiatives for industrial data platforms and connected systems.
* Transfer technical knowledge to lifecycle teams, contractors, vendors, developers, and support personnel to ensure sustainable long-term platform ownership.
* Take ownership of assigned technical activities and proactively drive issues to resolution while effectively communicating progress, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders.
* Ensure compliance with company procedures, quality standards, cybersecurity requirements, and engineering governance practices.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in information technology, Data Science, Automation, Industrial Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Engineering Technology, or a related discipline.
* Master's degree in a relevant technical discipline is preferred.
* Minimum 7 years of relevant professional experience supporting one or more of the following areas:
* OT/IT convergence
* Industrial automation
* IIoT and Smart Factory platforms
* Industrial data engineering
* Industrial IT
* Platform engineering
* Systems engineering
* Strong experience with industrial protocols and connectivity technologies such as OPC UA, MQTT, Siemens S7, or equivalent industrial communication protocols.
* Strong understanding of OT/IT networking concepts, including TCP/IP, routing, NAT, firewalls, DNS, certificates, and secure connectivity.
* Experience designing, implementing, or supporting industrial data pipelines, messaging platforms, and integration architectures.
* Experience working with industrial Historians, time-series databases, or similar industrial data platforms.
* Experience with Kubernetes, OpenShift, Docker, or other containerized deployment technologies.
* Experience with Litmus or equivalent industrial edge platforms is preferred.
* Experience with AVEVA Historian, QuestDB, PI System, Ignition Historian, or equivalent Historian/time-series database platforms is desirable.
* Experience with tag enablement, Historian/SCADA tag scaling, and configuration activities is preferred.
* Experience with Unified Namespace (UNS) architectures and industrial data contextualization is desirable.
* Experience working in multi-site manufacturing, industrial, process industry, energy, oil and gas, utilities, or brownfield operational environments is advantageous.
* Familiarity with industrial cybersecurity practices and standards such as IEC 62443.
* Experience supporting production platforms, operational support teams, and lifecycle management activities.
* Experience collaborating with external technology vendors, system integrators, and third-party service providers.
* Ability to develop and maintain solutions using Python, Go, TypeScript, Node-RED, or similar technologies.
* Experience with modern software development and operational practices including SLAs, change management, incident management, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across OT, IT, engineering, and business teams.
* Demonstrates ownership by taking responsibility for issues, following through on actions, and driving tasks to completion.
* Shows initiative, adaptability, and a proactive attitude while working across organizational and geographical boundaries.
* Produces accurate, maintainable, and well-documented technical solutions while maintaining high standards of quality and reliability.
* Comfortable working in a global environment with stakeholders across multiple regions and time zones.
* Willingness to travel internationally, including visits to Denmark and manufacturing sites as required.

**Location:**
Kochi, India

**Job Title:**
Project Management Specialist

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**About the Role**

Fragomen's US Capability Center in Kochi is seeking a
**Project Management Specialist**
to support Business teams in driving project execution, optimizing processes, and ensuring seamless coordination across teams. This role is instrumental in maintaining efficient project workflows, stakeholder communication, and continuous improvement efforts.

As a key liaison between client/office counterparts and internal teams, you will oversee project progress, conduct performance audits, and provide data-driven insights to support strategic decision-making. Additionally, you will monitor various initiatives, track key deliverables, and contribute to process optimization strategies to enhance overall efficiency.

We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive professional with strong analytical skills and exceptional communication abilities. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and enjoy streamlining project workflows, this role is for you!

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Project Execution & Oversight:**
  Collaborate with Business teams to ensure smooth project progression and mitigate risks, spanning scoping, developing, and execution of initiatives, while overseeing portfolio-wide progress, flagging at-risk projects, supporting governance and escalation pathways.
* **Stakeholder Communication & Coordination:**
  Act as a key liaison between internal teams and client/office counterparts, ensuring seamless collaboration through regular updates and structured reporting.
* **Data-Driven Insights & Trend Analysis:**
  Analyse project data, track key performance metrics, and provide reports to support business decisions.
* **Performance Monitoring & Continuous Improvement:**
  Ensure KPIs are consistently met and contribute to workflow optimization initiatives.
* **Meeting & Documentation Management:**
  Organize governance calls, lead weekly status meetings, and maintain structured project documentation.
* **Risk, Issue, and Change Management**
  : Identify, log, and actively manage project risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies — developing mitigation plans and escalating significant items in a timely, transparent manner, while managing scope and change control through impact assessment and stakeholder sign-off, and supporting change-management activities such as stakeholder readiness, communication, and adoption planning, with particular care for changes that touch live client casework.

**Preferred Qualifications & Skills**

**Education & Experience**

* Master’s degree in business administration, Project Management, or a related field.
* 8-10 years of experience in project management, preferably in a multinational environment.
* PMP, PRINCE2, CAPM, CSM, PSM, or other relevant project management certifications.
* Experience working with stakeholders across geographies and time zones.

**Technical & Professional Skills**

* Proficiency in project management tools (JIRA, Trello, MS Project, Asana).
* Strong analytical and reporting skills (Excel, Power BI, or similar tools).
* Knowledge of SDLC, Agile methodologies, Gantt charts, and compliance standards.

**Soft Skills & Competencies**

* Excellent organizational and multitasking abilities.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Proactive, solution-oriented mindset with keen attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating with global teams.

**Why Join Us?**

* Be part of a global leader in immigration services with opportunities for professional growth.
* Work in a dynamic, collaborative, and innovative environment.
* Gain exposure to international projects and diverse stakeholders.

If you’re ready to take on a role that challenges you while providing opportunities for growth, we’d love to hear from you!
**Apply now to be part of our team.**

 The Project Management Lead will support the planning, governance, coordination and execution of Executive Insights Command Centre initiatives for the USLI region. The successful candidate will combine strong project management capability, commercial awareness and effective communication across a global stakeholder environment.
   

  

 The position is designed for a proactive and commercially astute individual who thrives in a high\-impact environment, blending analytical depth with leadership accountability. Someone who co\-owns the delivery of priorities.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic Partnership \& Planning**

* Support the translation of strategic priorities and reporting requirements into structured initiatives, workplans and deliverables.

* Monitor milestones, dependencies, risks, scope changes and mitigation actions across multiple workstreams.
* Coordinate delivery across Markets, Service Lines, Global Analytics, Operations and reporting teams.
* Drive timely follow\-up and transparent reporting against agreed priorities and commitments.


**Leadership Enablement \& Communication**
* Enable leadership through preparation of board packs, pursuit reviews, external engagement prep, and issue resolution.
* Co\-lead strategic discussions and communications by managing board meetings, internal correspondence, and cross\-functional collaboration to ensure transparency, alignment, and seamless execution of go\-to\-market strategies.
* Monitor business KPIs, reporting service levels and operational performance measures.
* Partner with stakeholders to establish reporting standards, baselines, targets and performance tracking mechanisms.
* Identify and implement operational improvements, standardization and automation opportunities.


**Stakeholder Management**
* Build trusted relationships with USLI leadership and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Act as a central coordination point between business users, analytics teams and Power BI developers.
* Gather, clarify and prioritize stakeholder requirements and translate them into actionable delivery plans.
* Communicate progress, risks, decisions and recommendations clearly to senior stakeholders.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Consultative – demonstrate ability to approach problems and/or projects through effective question/answer techniques to identify needs/issues/desired outcomes and propose solutions to meet needs/issues/desired outcomes
* Risk management – Identify potential risks and create a mitigation plan
* Emotional Intelligence – demonstrate understanding of different working/personality styles and appreciation of the need to flex approach and message to effectively engage
* Project Management – experience building, and managing project plans with the ability to navigate challenges to achieve desired project outcomes

* Networking –strategically cultivating relationships across EY functions and Industry/Business development (BD) team by leveraging mutual interest and common goals for exchanging valuable insights and influencing actions to achieve account goals.
* Entrepreneur/Proactive behaviors – desire to make the role their own, create opportunities to involve themselves by displaying strong initiative, being innovative and adaptable, demonstrating visionary pursuit of value creation and business impact


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* 12\+ years of work experience
* A master’s degree or bachelor’s degree with relevant experience
* Relevant experience in project or program management, business operations, strategy execution, executive reporting or leadership enablement at a level appropriate for a Supervising Associate role.

title: Solar Project Manager
description:
We are expanding our residential rooftop solar operations across Kerala and need a practical, hands\-on Project Leader based in Kochi. Your main job is to take confirmed residential sales orders (mostly premium 3kW to 5kW residential systems) and get them installed, commissioned, and connected to the grid quickly without compromising on safety or structural quality.
 



  





 You will be actively managing our field supervisors, keeping external installation vendors in line, tracking local inventory, and dealing directly with KSEB to get net\-meters approved and commission solar projects. Prior experience managing residential rooftop solar projects is mandatory.
 



  





**What You Will Actually Do Day\-to\-Day** 
 :
 


* **End to End Project Execution** 
 : Oversee the day\-to\-day deployment of multiple residential rooftop solar projects simultaneously across key Kerala districts. Ensure all projects are completed on time, within budget, and to premium quality standards.
* **Team Leadership** 
 : Manage, mentor, and deploy a distributed team of site surveyors, field engineers, and installation supervisors. Establish strict safety protocols, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and quality checkpoints.
* **Vendor \& (I\&C) Management** 
 : Build, onboard, and manage a robust network of local Installation \& Commissioning (I\&C) teams and labor contractors. Negotiate rates, monitor daily progress, and audit their workmanship.
* **Procurement \& Inventory** 
 : Coordinate regional supply chain logistics. Manage structural, electrical, and component inventory (modules, inverters, structures, BoS) to ensure zero site\-delivery delays while minimizing local warehousing overheads.
* **DISCOM Liaisoning \& Subsidy paperwork** 
 : Own the relationship with KSEB officials to ensure seamless site inspections, structure approvals, and fast net\-metering synchronization. Ensure error\-free documentation for government subsidy claims.



  





**What We Are Looking For:** 



* **Education** 
 : B.Tech / Diploma in Electrical, Civil, or Mechanical Engineering.
* **Experience** 
 : 6 to 10\+ years in solar project management, with at least 2\+ years explicitly leading high\-volume residential or commercial rooftop solar installations.
* **Regulatory Knowledge** 
 : Deep familiarity with Kerala electrical safety regulations, DISCOM net\-metering procedures, and national portal subsidy guidelines.
* **Leadership Style** 
 : A hands\-on operational leader who split time between tracking timelines via project management tools and doing high\-audit site visits in the field.



**What’s in it for You:** 



* A fixed salary matching market standards.
* Performance bonuses tied directly to project turnaround time and zero\-defect quality audits.
* A direct line to the founders and the opportunity to scale our operational blueprint across the region.

title: Operations and Control Tower Lead
description:
**About the Role** 




 We are looking for an execution\-focused Operations \& Control Tower Lead to manage the operational engine behind our residential rooftop solar deployments.
 



  





 In this role, you will lead the central control desk that bridges sales, engineering, local utilities, banks, and the customer. You will be directly responsible for eliminating project bottlenecks—ensuring that every residential project clears financing, approvals, procurement, dispatch, and final grid synchronization without delays or paperwork friction.
 



  





 You will also manage a dedicated customer success and coordination team, ensuring homeowners experience proactive, transparent communication from the moment a contract is signed to final commissioning.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Central Order\-to\-Delivery Ownership** 
 : Run the central operations desk tracking residential projects from contract signing through to final commissioning and handoff.
* **Customer Success Desk Management** 
 : Lead and coach a team of customer coordinators/relationship executives. Set clear service\-level agreements (SLAs), communication cadences, and escalation protocols so customers are continuously updated via WhatsApp, calls, and email.
* **Financing \& Banking Coordination** 
 : Work directly with partner banks and NBFCs to track customer solar loan applications, push fast document verification, and secure timely disbursements.
* **Utility \& Regulatory Approvals** 
 : Drive all documentation and registration workflows with local electricity boards (such as KSEB) for initial feasibility approvals, net\-metering allocations, and final site inspections.
* **Government Portal \& Subsidy Management** 
 : Oversee end\-to\-end documentation, portal applications, and compliance filings for central/state solar subsidy programs to achieve zero document rejection rates.
* **Supply Chain \& Field Alignment** 
 : Act as the operational bridge between field sales teams, project engineers, and central inventory. Authorize site dispatch triggers only after ensuring full commercial and documentation clearance.
* **Data \& SLA Tracking** 
 : Maintain absolute data integrity across CRM and operations dashboards. Track and optimize operational metrics, including time\-to\-dispatch, utility approval cycle times, and overall project turnaround times (TAT).
* **Metrics you will own** 
 : Revenue, TAT for financial closure, Outstanding collections
* **Metrics you will be tracking** 
 and influencing the org: Dispatch \& Installation TAT, Overall project TAT, Customer NPS



**What We Are Looking For** 



* **Experience** 
 : 10\+ years of hands\-on operations experience in roles such as Project Operations Lead, Order\-to\-Delivery Manager, Operations Control Tower, or Post\-Sales Operations Lead.
* **High bias for action** 
 : Ability to arrive at the next step, given conflicting constraints around the situation, most of the project situations need quick reaction.
* **Domain Familiarity** 
 : Prior experience in residential rooftop solar, retail banking operations (home/consumer loan processing), telecom/broadband network deployments, or high\-value residential installations.
* **Team Leadership** 
 : At least 4\+ years managing a customer support, back\-office operations, or project tracking team.
* **Process Fluency:** 
 Practical working knowledge in complex processes, typically involving multiple external agencies/portals. Ability to assess process flows and make changes. Ability to root\-cause situations that arise in day to day project flows.
* **Problem Solver** 
 : Highly organized individual with strong troubleshooting abilities who can unblock administrative hold\-ups and maintain strict accountability across teams.
* **Languages** 
 : Fluency in Malayalam and English is mandatory to effectively manage local coordination and cross\-functional operations.



  





**What We Offer** 



* Competitive fixed compensation structure.
* Performance bonuses linked to operational velocity, turnaround times, and customer satisfaction metrics.
* A high\-impact role driving the core operational backbone of a fast\-growing residential clean\-tech business.

 The successful candidate will combine Learning \& Development consulting, organisational change management, proposal development, facilitation and responsible AI usage. One of the two Senior Consultant vacancies will require demonstrated business\-level Arabic proficiency.

**Learning transformation and change management**

* Apply instructional design methods such as ADDIE or SAM to learning journeys, curricula, academies, leadership programmes and capability\-building interventions.
* Develop learning operating model, managed learning services, governance, intake, content operations and performance\-measurement components where relevant.
* Support leadership assessment\-led development assignments, including administration and interpretation when appropriately accredited, and convert insights into development pathways.
* Use evaluation and analytics approaches to measure participation, learning transfer, adoption and business impact.


**Pursuits, proposals and business development**

* Analyse RFP requirements, develop compliance matrices and help create differentiated win themes and client\-specific solution stories under tight turnaround times.
* Create proposal slides, capability showcases, credentials, case studies, benchmarks and sector research for MENA partner and account teams.
* Participate in partner reviews, solution workshops and oral presentation preparation; present assigned sections confidently when required.
* Identify follow\-on opportunities during delivery and shape them into a clear problem statement, proposed response and indicative scope.


**AI\-enabled learning and technology**
* Use Microsoft Copilot and other approved generative AI tools for research, synthesis, proposal development, learning design and content acceleration in line with firm policies.
* Design AI\-enabled learning use cases, with particular emphasis on a learning content generation accelerator, personalised journeys and analytics\-assisted decisions.
* Apply human review, factual verification, accessibility, privacy, confidentiality, intellectual property and quality controls to AI\-assisted output.
* Bring working knowledge of LXP, AI learning platforms, talent marketplaces, LMS ecosystems and learning analytics to solution design.
* Guide Staff Consultants in effective prompt design, AI\-assisted production and responsible review practices.


**Capability building and internal contribution**
* Build and maintain reusable proposal content, credentials, case studies, research, methods, templates and delivery assets.
* Convert project learning into portfolio intellectual property and support capability demonstrations and internal roadshows.
* Contribute to recruitment assessments, onboarding, coaching, certification pathways and community\-of\-practice activity.
* Balance client delivery with pursuit and capability commitments in a lean, growth\-stage team.

* Facilitation and design thinking: designs productive workshops and moves diverse stakeholders towards decisions.
* Client communication: produces director\-ready documents and communicates confidently in virtual and in\-person settings.
* AI fluency: uses AI to increase speed and quality while retaining human accountability and professional scepticism.
* Builder mindset: creates reusable capability while meeting immediate delivery requirements.

* 7–9 years of relevant experience across L\&D consulting, learning transformation and organisational change management.
* Demonstrated client\-facing consulting experience and independent ownership of learning or change workstreams.
* Evidence of contribution to RFPs, solution approaches, proposal writing, effort estimation and presentation development.
* Depth in learning strategy, needs analysis, curriculum and journey design, facilitation, evaluation and capability building.
* Practical experience in change impacts, stakeholder engagement, communications, readiness, adoption and reinforcement.
* Hands\-on use of generative AI and Microsoft Copilot for consulting, proposals or learning work.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, HR, education, organisational development, psychology or a related discipline.

* Exposure to LXP, AI learning platforms, talent marketplaces and learning analytics.

title: Learning and Change Transformation - Staff
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY GDS \| PEOPLE CONSULTING \| LEARNING \& CHANGE**
 Staff Consultant, Learning \& Change
   

  

 Build consulting craft. Create with AI. Connect across languages.
   

  

**ROLE SNAPSHOT**
**Role**
 Staff Consultant, Learning \& Change
   

  

**Portfolio**
 Learning \& Development, People Consulting MENA
   

  

**Experience**
 2–4 years of relevant professional experience
   

  

**Capability model**
 Learning consulting with organisational change capability and AI\-enabled ways of working
   

  

**THE OPPORTUNITY**
 This role is an entry point into a consulting career in Learning and Change within EY GDS People Consulting. You will contribute to live MENA client work, strategic proposals and capability\-building initiatives across government, energy and financial services, with KSA as the primary growth market.
   

  

 You will own defined pieces of work, such as a storyboard, learning asset, stakeholder map, research pack, proposal section, workshop pack, readiness tracker or dashboard. The role blends learning design, change enablement, digital learning, project coordination and responsible use of AI. It is not a learning administration\-only position.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Learning design and capability development**
* Support learning needs analysis, learner personas, skills\-gap reviews and role\-to\-capability mapping
* Help design learning journeys, curriculum maps, course outlines and blended learning experiences across ILT, VILT, WBT, microlearning and performance support.
* Develop e\-learning modules, storyboards, facilitator and learner guides, job aids, simulations, quick\-reference guides, assessments and reinforcement assets.
* Use adult learning principles and instructional design methods such as ADDIE or SAM, under guidance from senior team members.
* Support learning evaluation, feedback analysis, knowledge assessment and outcome reporting.


**Organisational change and adoption support**
* Maintain stakeholder registers, change\-impact logs, readiness trackers and adoption dashboards.
* Support stakeholder analysis, focus groups, surveys and workshop output synthesis.
* Draft change communications, campaign content, FAQs, toolkits and champion\-network materials for review.
* Assist with readiness, adoption and reinforcement activities that connect learning to business change outcomes.


**Pursuits, proposals and market support**
* Conduct structured client, sector, benchmark and competitor research for RFPs, RFQs and proactive proposals.
* Draft proposal content, credentials, CVs, case studies, methodology slides, workplan inputs and capability\-showcase materials.
* Create clear, consulting\-quality PowerPoint materials and maintain version control under tight deadlines.
* Review source material, support proposal content and participate in stakeholder discussions.
* Help maintain the capability, proposal and case\-study repositories.


**Client delivery, facilitation and learning operations**
* Own defined deliverables and project tasks, track dependencies and raise risks early.
* Prepare workshop materials, digital collaboration boards, logistics, attendance and feedback instruments; capture and structure outputs.
* Facilitate selected portions of learning sessions, focus groups and working meetings under appropriate supervision.
* Support learning intake, schedules, deployment, LMS or LXP content setup, testing, reporting and post\-course sustainment where included in project scope.
* Build collaborative working relationships with client contacts, subject\-matter experts and internal teams.


**AI\-enabled learning and digital content**
* Use Microsoft Copilot and other approved generative AI tools for research, synthesis, proposal support, storyboarding, assessment generation and content development.
* Apply human review, fact\-checking, privacy, copyright, accessibility and quality controls to all AI\-assisted outputs.
* Contribute to AI\-enabled learning use cases, including learning content generation, microlearning, personalised pathways and analytics support.
* Create or edit digital learning assets using tools such as Articulate Storyline and Rise, Captivate, Vyond, Camtasia, Synthesia, Clipchamp or comparable platforms.
* Support content upload, testing and reporting on platforms such as SuccessFactors Learning, Cornerstone, Workday Learning, Degreed, Docebo, SharePoint or similar environments.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Consulting potential: Structures information clearly, asks good questions and connects deliverables to the client need.
* Written and visual communication: Produces concise English and well\-structured presentations with strong attention to detail.
* AI fluency: Uses AI productively and responsibly rather than treating generated output as final.
* Design sensibility: Understands learning experience, usability, visual hierarchy and audience needs.
* Ownership and coachability: Closes assigned work, raises risks early and applies feedback quickly.
* Organisation: Manages several tasks, deadlines and versions without losing quality.


**Qualifications And Experience**
**Essentia**
* 1–3 years of relevant experience in learning design, L\&D, content development, training delivery, change support, HR or organisational development, consulting or a related area.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, human resources, education, psychology, organisational development, communication, design or a related discipline.
* Working knowledge of adult learning principles and instructional design; exposure to ADDIE, SAM or comparable methods.
* Experience creating professional presentations, learning content, communications or structured business documents.
* Strong Microsoft PowerPoint, Word and Excel capability; familiarity with digital collaboration tools.
* Practical use of Microsoft Copilot or comparable generative AI tools for research, synthesis or content creation, with evidence of responsible review.
* Demonstrated business\-level proficiency to review proposal content, take part in stakeholder discussions and support workshops.
* Excellent spoken and written English and willingness to support MENA working hours.


**Preferred**
* Experience in a consulting, professional\-services, GCC\-facing or shared\-services environment.
* Exposure to organisational change frameworks.
* Hands\-on experience with at least one digital learning authoring or media tool.
* Exposure to LMS, LXP, digital adoption platforms, learning analytics or Power BI.
* Experience supporting proposals, market research, credentials or business\-development materials.
* Exposure to government, energy or financial\-services contexts.


**CERTIFICATIONS AND DEVELOPMENT**
 Required at joining or within the agreed development plan Preferred / differentiating
   

  

* Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI or comparable applied AI fundamentals
* Design thinking / human\-centred design foundation
* Instructional design or adult learning foundation
* Change management foundation or agreed pathway
* PROSCI foundation or equivalent
* APTD or similar learning credential
* Agile fundamentals
* Articulate, learning platform or learning analytics credential


**WAYS OF WORKING**
 Initial ramp\-up: approximately 50% client delivery, 30% pursuits and proposals, 10% capability building and 10% internal initiatives, subject to demand and staffing.
   

  

 Once deployed to a billable engagement: approximately 70% client delivery and 30% pursuits, proposal support and capability building, subject to engagement commitments and portfolio priorities.
   

  

**KEY SUCCESS MEASURES: FIRST 12 MONTHS**
**Dimension**
**Delivery**
 Support at least one significant learning or change workstream; deliver assigned outputs at first or second review with limited rework. Workplan, review records and engagement feedback.
   

  

**Pursuits**
 Support at least 5 strategic pursuits and contribute substantive content to at least 3 proposal submissions, subject to pipeline volume. Pursuit tracker and proposal records.
   

  

**AI adoption**
 Demonstrate responsible AI\-assisted working in research, proposals or content; contribute to one AI\-enabled learning use case or accelerator. Approved work samples, demo or use\-case record.
   

  

**Capability assets**
 Create or materially improve at least 2 reusable assets, templates, credentials or case studies. Repository and reuse log.
   

  

**Digital learning**
 Demonstrate working competence in at least one authoring or media tool and exposure to one learning platform or analytics tool. Skills assessment or project evidence.
   

  

**Growth**
 Complete agreed learning, change and AI development milestones and show progress toward Consultant readiness. Development plan and certification record.
   

  

**Utilisation**
 Meet the approved grade utilisation target and agreed delivery/BD allocation, with targets calibrated to actual staffing. Utilisation and resource reports.
   

  

**What Ey Offers**
* Exposure to live MENA learning, change, digital adoption and workforce capability programmes.
* A structured pathway across learning consulting, organisational change, AI\-enabled learning and consulting craft.
* Hands\-on experience with modern authoring tools, learning platforms, analytics and approved AI tools.
* Coaching from experienced consultants and the opportunity to shape a growing portfolio.
* A career path from Staff Consultant to broader workstream and solution ownership.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: MEP DESIGN COORDINATOR
description:
**Company Description** 




  





 Creo Homes Pvt Ltd is a leading architectural design and turnkey construction company based in Kochi, Kerala, specializing in luxury homes that blend creativity, quality, and ethics. The company brings together architects, engineers, interior designers, and skilled craftsmen to deliver personalized living spaces that reflect each client’s aspirations. Covering architecture, construction, interiors, and landscaping under one roof, Creo Homes offers a seamless, end\-to\-end project experience. Every project is guided by responsibility, respect, and a strong focus on customer satisfaction, ensuring excellence in every detail. With a vision to become one of India’s most trusted home design brands, the company aims to expand to 20 cities by 2035 through innovation, robust systems, and a client\-first culture.
 



  





**Role Description** 



* The MEP Design Coordinator is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Ernakulam, responsible for coordinating Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing design across residential projects.
* This role involves reviewing and integrating MEP drawings with architectural and structural designs, ensuring technical accuracy and compliance with relevant codes and standards.
* The coordinator will manage design submittals, track approvals, and collaborate closely with architects, engineers, contractors, and vendors to resolve design clashes and execution issues.
* Day\-to\-day tasks include preparing and updating design documentation, supporting project planning and scheduling, attending site coordination meetings, and providing technical guidance to site teams.
* The position also requires monitoring design changes, maintaining clear communication among stakeholders, and contributing to quality, safety, and cost\-effective design solutions.



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* Diploma / B.Tech / B.E. in Mechanical, Electrical, Civil or related engineering field.
* 2–5 years of relevant experience in MEP coordination or construction projects.
* Experience in residential / villa / turnkey projects will be an advantage.
* Good knowledge of electrical and plumbing systems.
* Basic knowledge of HVAC and other building services.
* Proficiency in
 **AutoCAD** 
 is required.

title: ADTL/DTL
description:
Job Overview
   

 Manage end\-to\-end delivery of data management services for single/multi\-service projects with minimal guidance, ensuring quality deliverables on time and within budget, to customer satisfaction. Provide comprehensive data management expertise to Data Management (DM) team to provide high quality data management products that meet customer needs. Provide leadership to the team in the areas of project planning, execution, and close\-out; Overview of financial management for data management activities; communications; and milestone deliverables. Perform role of Data Team Lead (DTL). 
 



 Essential Functions
   

 • Gather Study Set up requirements through discussion and communication with relevant stakeholders.
   

 • With Minimal guidance \- support, overview of validation of new Device integrations.
   

 • Oversight \& Perform regular Data cleaning activities to ensure clean data with quality and timely deliverables to sponsor.
   

 • Ensure that all the deliverables are of expected quality standards and meet customer expectations.
   

 • With guidance, ensure service and quality meet agreed upon timelines and deliverables in contract/Scope of Work (SOW).
   

 • Support Training of New joiners.
   

 • Lead internal study meetings and internal/ sponsor audits and participate in Study Kick off meetings and other sponsor meetings.
   

 • Tracks and manages the projects, oversee project progress, identify risks and take corrective action to rectify any errors as recommended as required.
   

 • With Guidance manage \& oversight the implementation of new technology / database revisions.
   

 • Work closely with the programming team for process innovation and automation.
   

 • Be compliant to trainings and eSOP reading.
   

 • Provide review and expert opinion in developing, revising, and maintaining core operating procedures and working instructions.
   

 • Communication with Line Manager, and other team members across functions should be collaborative.
   

 • Perform other duties as directed by Line Manager.
 



 Qualifications
   

 • Bachelor's Degree In health, clinical, biological or mathematical sciences, or related field with proven experience in Data Management Req
   

 • 3 \-4 years direct Data Management experience, including a minimum of 1 year as a CDM project lead. Pref
   

 • English Fluency Spoken and English Advanced
   

 • Advanced computer applications like Microsoft excel, word, Inbox etc Advanced
   

 • Should have Advanced understanding of Drug development lifecycle and Overall Clinical research process Advanced

description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**Service line \- Position Title: Consulting \- SAP TRM Manager**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. title: Project Coordinator
description:
**Company Description** 
 Riafy Technologies partners with leading global brands to think, ideate, build, and grow digital products that create meaningful impact. Its consumer apps are used by over 100 million people in 160 countries and 23 languages, and trusted by partners such as Google, Apple, Siemens, Sony, major banks, airlines, and FMCG leaders. Riafy’s apps rank in the top 1% globally, with multiple recognitions from Google, including Editor’s Choice and Top Developer badges, and repeated showcases at Google I/O. The company’s proprietary Generative AI platform, R10, powers enterprise\-grade AI agents across sectors like banking, aviation, automotive, telecom, healthcare, beauty, FMCG, and manufacturing. Riafy fosters a culture of belonging, inclusion, and diversity, has tripled in size in recent years, and was honored with the Google Partner Award 2023 for DEI in APAC.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Project Coordinator role at Riafy Technologies is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Kochi. This role involves coordinating project activities, tracking timelines and deliverables, and ensuring clear communication among cross\-functional teams such as product, engineering, design, and client stakeholders. The Project Coordinator will assist in preparing project plans, status reports, and documentation, and will help identify risks and dependencies to keep initiatives on schedule and within scope. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include organizing meetings, maintaining task lists and project dashboards, supporting resource allocation, and following up on action items. The role also includes contributing to process improvements, supporting quality assurance efforts, and helping ensure that projects align with partner expectations and Riafy’s standards for innovation and impact.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong project coordination and organizational skills, including experience with scheduling, task tracking, and maintaining project documentation.
* Ability to communicate clearly and professionally with diverse stakeholders, with strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Familiarity with project management tools and methodologies (e.g., Agile, Scrum, Kanban) and basic understanding of software or digital product development lifecycles.
* Analytical and problem\-solving abilities, with attention to detail and a focus on meeting deadlines and quality standards.
* Comfort working in fast\-paced, cross\-functional environments; ability to prioritize and manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, business, management, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience in tech, SaaS, AI, or digital product companies is an advantage, especially exposure to enterprise solutions or global clients.
* Commitment to inclusive, collaborative teamwork and openness to learning new tools, processes, and technologies.

* Prepare periodic operational, financial, maintenance and compliance reports.

* Maintain effective relationships with government authorities, consultants, vendors and other external stakeholders.

* Planning, coordination and execution.
* Vendor and contract management.

* Statutory and regulatory compliance.
* Health, safety and security management.
* Negotiation and Relationship management.
* Problem\-solving and decision\-making.

 Graduation in any discipline.
 



 Professional certification in Facilities/Property Management will be an added advantage.

 6 to 8 Years of experience in property management, facilities management, real estate, hospitality, commercial buildings, residential projects or a similar environment. Experience in managing large properties, multiple vendors and multidisciplinary teams will be preferred. Experience in liasoning with Governmental Organization’s will be preferred.
